recipes.title: Crispy Air-Fried French Fries
recipes.search: crispy air-fried french fries crispy air-fried french fries airfryer – fry 200°c 19 min — serves 4 prep ahead: soak cut potatoes in water for 20 minutes before cooking to remove excess starch. ingredients 4 medium potatoes, cut into fries 1 tbsp oil 1 tsp salt 1/2 tsp paprika (optional) method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 200°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 soak cut potatoes in water for 20 minutes, then pat completely dry. 3 toss with the oil, salt and paprika. 4 place in the basket in a single layer; air-fry at 200°c for 19 minutes, shaking the basket every 5 minutes. 5 serve hot with ketchup or a dip of choice. tip: soaking removes excess starch and is the real secret to crispiness.

recipes.title: Crunchy Vegetable Spring Rolls
recipes.search: crunchy vegetable spring rolls crunchy vegetable spring rolls airfryer – bake 180°c 11 min (12 rolls) — serves 4 prep ahead: cook and cool the vegetable filling completely before rolling, so wrappers don’t turn soggy. ingredients 12 spring roll wrappers 1 cup mixed shredded cabbage, carrot, capsicum 1 tbsp soy sauce 1/2 tsp black pepper (kali mirch) oil spray method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 180°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 stir-fry vegetables briefly with soy sauce and pepper; cool completely. 3 roll filling tightly in wrappers, sealing edges with a little water. 4 spray rolls lightly with oil and arrange with space between each. 5 air-fry at 180°c for 11 minutes, turning once, until golden and crisp.

recipes.title: Masala Peanuts
recipes.search: masala peanuts masala peanuts airfryer – fry 180°c 9 min — serves 4 ingredients 1 cup raw peanuts 1 tbsp gram flour (besan) 1/2 tsp red chilli powder (lal mirch powder) 1/4 tsp turmeric (haldi) 1/2 tsp oil salt to taste few curry leaves (kadi patta) method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 180°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 toss peanuts with gram flour, spices, oil and salt until evenly coated. 3 spread in a single layer in the basket. 4 air-fry at 180°c for 9 minutes, shaking every 3 minutes, until crisp. 5 toss in curry leaves for the last 2 minutes. tip: let peanuts cool fully before storing — they crisp up further as they cool.

recipes.title: Stuffed Mushrooms
recipes.search: stuffed mushrooms stuffed mushrooms airfryer – bake 180°c 11 min — serves 4 ingredients 11 button mushrooms, stems removed 1/4 cup grated cheese 2 tbsp breadcrumbs 1 tsp garlic (lehsun), minced 1 tbsp chopped parsley salt & pepper to taste oil spray method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 180°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 mix cheese, breadcrumbs, garlic, parsley, salt and pepper. 3 spoon mixture into each mushroom cap. 4 arrange in the basket and spray lightly with oil. 5 bake at 180°c for 11 minutes until tops are golden and mushrooms are tender.

recipes.title: Bread Pizza Bites
recipes.search: bread pizza bites bread pizza bites airfryer – bake 180°c 7 min — serves 4 ingredients 4 bread slices 3 tbsp pizza/tomato sauce 1/2 cup grated mozzarella chopped capsicum & onion 1/2 tsp oregano oil spray method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 180°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 spread sauce on bread slices; top with vegetables and cheese. 3 sprinkle oregano and cut each slice into quarters. 4 arrange in the basket, spray lightly with oil. 5 bake at 180°c for 7 minutes until cheese melts and edges are crisp.

recipes.title: Crispy Corn Cheese Balls
recipes.search: crispy corn cheese balls crispy corn cheese balls airfryer – fry 190°c 11 min makes ~12 ingredients 1 cup boiled sweet corn, lightly mashed 1/2 cup mashed potato 1/2 cup grated cheese 2 tbsp cornflour 1/2 tsp black pepper (kali mirch) salt to taste 1/2 cup breadcrumbs oil spray method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 190°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 mix corn, potato, cheese, cornflour, pepper and salt; shape into small balls. 3 roll each ball in breadcrumbs to coat evenly. 4 spray lightly with oil and place in the basket, spaced apart. 5 air-fry at 190°c for 11 minutes, shaking halfway, until golden and crisp.

recipes.title: Chilli Garlic Potato Wedges
recipes.search: chilli garlic potato wedges chilli garlic potato wedges airfryer – fry 200°c 19 min — serves 4 ingredients 3 large potatoes, cut into wedges 1 tbsp oil 1 tsp chilli flakes 1 tsp garlic (lehsun) powder 1/2 tsp smoked paprika salt to taste method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 200°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 toss wedges with oil and all seasonings until evenly coated. 3 arrange in a single layer in the basket. 4 air-fry at 200°c for 19 minutes, shaking every 5 minutes, until crisp outside and soft inside. 5 serve with a garlic dip or ketchup.

recipes.title: Crispy Onion Rings
recipes.search: crispy onion rings crispy onion rings airfryer – fry 190°c 11 min — serves 4 prep ahead: soak sliced onions in cold water 10 minutes to mellow the bite before battering. ingredients 2 large onions, sliced into rings 1/2 cup flour 1/2 tsp baking powder 1/2 cup milk 1 cup breadcrumbs or panko salt & pepper to taste oil spray method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 190°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 whisk flour, baking powder, milk, salt and pepper into a smooth batter. 3 dip onion rings in the batter, then coat well in breadcrumbs. 4 spray with oil and arrange in the basket in a single layer. 5 air-fry at 190°c for 11 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and crisp.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Mozzarella Sticks
recipes.search: air fryer mozzarella sticks air fryer mozzarella sticks airfryer – fry 190°c 7 min makes ~10 prep ahead: freeze the coated cheese sticks for at least 30 minutes before air-frying, or they’ll ooze out. ingredients 10 mozzarella string cheese sticks, halved 1/2 cup flour 2 eggs, beaten 1 cup breadcrumbs 1 tsp italian seasoning oil spray method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 190°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 coat each cheese stick in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs mixed with italian seasoning; repeat the egg and breadcrumb layer for a thicker coat. 3 freeze coated sticks for at least 30 minutes. 4 spray with oil and arrange in the basket, spaced apart. 5 air-fry at 190°c for 7 minutes until golden, watching closely so cheese doesn’t burst out.

recipes.title: Crispy Cauliflower Bites
recipes.search: crispy cauliflower bites crispy cauliflower bites airfryer – fry 200°c 16 min — serves 4 ingredients 1 medium cauliflower, cut into florets 1/2 cup flour 1/2 cup water 1 tsp garlic (lehsun) powder 1 tsp paprika salt to taste 1 cup breadcrumbs oil spray 2 tbsp hot sauce + 1 tbsp butter, melted (toss at the end) method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 200°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 whisk flour, water, garlic powder, paprika and salt into a thick batter. 3 dip florets in batter, then coat in breadcrumbs. 4 spray with oil and arrange in a single layer in the basket. 5 air-fry at 200°c for 16 minutes, shaking halfway, until golden; toss in hot sauce and butter before serving.

recipes.title: Popcorn Paneer
recipes.search: popcorn paneer popcorn paneer airfryer – fry 190°c 12 min — serves 4 vegetarian • high-protein • everyday ingredients 400g paneer, cut into bite-sized cubes 1/2 cup cornflour 1/4 cup all-purpose flour 1 tsp red chilli powder 1/2 tsp garlic powder salt to taste 1/2 cup buttermilk or milk 1 cup breadcrumbs oil spray method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 190°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 soak the paneer cubes in buttermilk for 10 minutes. 3 mix the cornflour, flour, chilli powder, garlic powder and salt in a bowl. 4 drain the paneer, toss in the flour mix, then coat in breadcrumbs, pressing to help them stick. 5 spray lightly with oil and arrange in the basket, spaced apart. 6 air-fry at 190°c for 10–12 minutes, shaking halfway, until golden and crisp. tip: soaking the paneer in buttermilk first keeps it soft and juicy inside while the coating turns delightfully crisp.

recipes.title: Peri Peri Paneer
recipes.search: peri peri paneer peri peri paneer airfryer – marinate 30 min + grill 200°c 12 min — serves 4 gluten-free • vegetarian • high-protein • everyday prep ahead: marinate the paneer for at least 30 minutes (up to 2 hours for deeper flavour). ingredients 400g paneer, cut into 1-inch cubes 3 tbsp peri peri sauce (or blended red chillies, garlic, paprika, lemon juice and oil) 1 tbsp lemon juice 1 tbsp oil 1/2 tsp smoked paprika 1 capsicum, cut into 1-inch squares 1 onion, cut into 1-inch squares salt to taste method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 200°c for 4 minutes before adding the food. 2 whisk together the peri peri sauce, lemon juice, oil, paprika and salt. 3 gently toss the paneer, capsicum and onion in the marinade, coating well, and rest for at least 30 minutes. 4 thread onto skewers, or arrange loose in a single layer in the airfryer basket. 5 grill at 200°c for 12 minutes, turning or shaking halfway, until charred at the edges. tip: paneer can turn rubbery if overcooked — pull it as soon as the edges char, since it firms up a little more as it cools.

recipes.title: Popcorn Mushroom
recipes.search: popcorn mushroom popcorn mushroom airfryer – fry 190°c 12 min — serves 3 vegetarian • everyday ingredients 300g button mushrooms, halved or quartered 1/2 cup cornflour 1/4 cup all-purpose flour 1/2 tsp black pepper 1/2 tsp garlic powder salt to taste 1/2 cup buttermilk 1 cup breadcrumbs oil spray method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 190°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 soak the mushrooms in buttermilk for 10 minutes. 3 mix the cornflour, flour, pepper, garlic powder and salt in a bowl. 4 drain the mushrooms, toss in the flour mix, then coat in breadcrumbs. 5 spray lightly with oil and arrange in the basket in a single layer. 6 air-fry at 190°c for 10–12 minutes, shaking halfway, until golden and crisp. tip: mushrooms release moisture as they cook, so don't overcrowd the basket — cook in batches if needed for maximum crunch.

recipes.title: Popcorn Cauliflower (Gobi Popcorn)
recipes.search: popcorn cauliflower (gobi popcorn) popcorn cauliflower (gobi popcorn) airfryer – fry 190°c 14 min — serves 4 vegetarian • everyday ingredients 1 medium cauliflower, cut into small florets 1/2 cup cornflour 1/4 cup all-purpose flour 1 tsp red chilli powder 1/2 tsp ginger-garlic paste salt to taste 1/2 cup water 1 cup breadcrumbs oil spray method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 190°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 whisk the cornflour, flour, chilli powder, ginger-garlic paste, salt and water into a thick batter. 3 dip the cauliflower florets in the batter, letting excess drip off, then coat in breadcrumbs. 4 spray lightly with oil and arrange in the basket in a single layer. 5 air-fry at 190°c for 12–14 minutes, shaking halfway, until golden and crisp. tip: cut the florets small and even — bite-sized pieces cook through and crisp up far more reliably than large chunks.

recipes.title: Popcorn Tofu
recipes.search: popcorn tofu popcorn tofu airfryer – fry 190°c 14 min — serves 4 vegetarian • high-protein • everyday ingredients 400g firm tofu, cut into bite-sized cubes 1/2 cup cornflour 1/4 cup all-purpose flour 1/2 tsp smoked paprika 1/2 tsp garlic powder salt to taste 1/2 cup buttermilk (or plant milk with 1 tsp vinegar) 1 cup breadcrumbs oil spray method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 190°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 pat the tofu dry, then soak in the buttermilk for 10 minutes. 3 mix the cornflour, flour, paprika, garlic powder and salt in a bowl. 4 drain the tofu, toss in the flour mix, then coat in breadcrumbs. 5 spray lightly with oil and arrange in the basket in a single layer. 6 air-fry at 190°c for 12–14 minutes, shaking halfway, until golden and crisp. tip: pressing the tofu for 15 minutes before cutting helps remove excess water, so the coating crisps up instead of steaming off.

recipes.title: Cheese Corn Nuggets
recipes.search: cheese corn nuggets cheese corn nuggets airfryer – fry 190°c 12 min — makes ~14 vegetarian • everyday ingredients 1.5 cups boiled sweet corn, roughly mashed 1/2 cup grated cheese 3 tbsp cornflour 2 tbsp all-purpose flour 1/2 tsp black pepper salt to taste 1 cup breadcrumbs oil spray method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 190°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 mix the corn, cheese, cornflour, flour, pepper and salt into a thick, shapeable mixture. 3 shape into small nugget-sized ovals. 4 roll each nugget in breadcrumbs, pressing to coat evenly. 5 spray lightly with oil and arrange in the basket, spaced apart. 6 air-fry at 190°c for 10–12 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and crisp. tip: if the mixture feels too soft to shape, chill it in the fridge for 15 minutes first — it firms up and holds together much better.

recipes.title: Roasted Makhana (Fox Nuts)
recipes.search: roasted makhana (fox nuts) roasted makhana (fox nuts) airfryer – roast 160°c 9 min — serves 4 ingredients 2 cups makhana (fox nuts) 1 tbsp ghee or oil 1/2 tsp black salt 1/4 tsp red chilli powder (lal mirch powder) 1/4 tsp roasted cumin powder (bhuna jeera powder) method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 160°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 toss makhana with ghee and spices until evenly coated. 3 spread in a single layer in the basket. 4 roast at 160°c for 9 minutes, shaking every 3 minutes, until crisp. 5 cool completely before storing in an airtight container. tip: makhana crisps up further as it cools — don’t judge crunchiness straight out of the basket.

recipes.title: Crispy Banana Chips
recipes.search: crispy banana chips crispy banana chips airfryer – fry 170°c 16 min — serves 4 prep ahead: soak sliced raw bananas in salted turmeric water for 10 minutes to prevent browning. ingredients 2 raw (green) bananas, thinly sliced 1/2 tsp turmeric (haldi) 1 tsp salt 1 tbsp oil method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 170°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 soak banana slices in water with turmeric and salt for 10 minutes; drain and pat dry. 3 toss with oil. 4 arrange in a single layer in the basket. 5 air-fry at 170°c for 16 minutes, shaking every 5 minutes, until crisp and lightly golden.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Masala Omelette Muffins
recipes.search: air fryer masala omelette muffins air fryer masala omelette muffins airfryer – bake 160°c 11 min — serves 2 (makes 6) ingredients 4 eggs 1/4 cup chopped onion, tomato, capsicum 1/4 tsp turmeric (haldi) 1/2 tsp black pepper (kali mirch) salt to taste 2 tbsp milk oil spray for muffin cups method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 160°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 whisk eggs with milk, turmeric, pepper and salt; stir in chopped vegetables. 3 pour into greased silicone or metal muffin cups that fit the basket. 4 bake at 160°c for 11 minutes until set and lightly golden on top. 5 cool slightly before removing from cups.

recipes.title: Crispy Air Fryer Hash Browns
recipes.search: crispy air fryer hash browns crispy air fryer hash browns airfryer – fry 200°c 16 min — serves 4 prep ahead: grate potatoes and squeeze out as much water as possible before mixing — this is key to crispness. ingredients 3 potatoes, grated and squeezed dry 1 tbsp cornflour 1/2 tsp salt 1/4 tsp black pepper (kali mirch) 1 tbsp oil method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 200°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 mix grated potato with cornflour, salt, pepper and oil. 3 shape into flat patties. 4 place in the basket in a single layer. 5 air-fry at 200°c for 16 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and crisp. tip: squeezing out as much water as possible from the potato is key to crispness.

recipes.title: Stuffed French Toast Sticks
recipes.search: stuffed french toast sticks stuffed french toast sticks airfryer – bake 170°c 9 min — serves 2 ingredients 4 bread slices 2 tbsp cream cheese or nutella 1 egg 2 tbsp milk 1/2 tsp cinnamon (dalchini) 1 tsp sugar method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 170°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 spread filling on two bread slices, top with remaining slices to make sandwiches, then cut into sticks. 3 whisk egg, milk, cinnamon and sugar; dip each stick briefly. 4 arrange in the basket, spaced apart. 5 bake at 170°c for 9 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden.

recipes.title: Paneer Bhurji Toast
recipes.search: paneer bhurji toast paneer bhurji toast airfryer – bake 180°c 9 min — serves 2 vegetarian • high-protein • everyday ingredients 200g paneer, crumbled 4 bread slices 1/4 cup chopped onion, tomato, capsicum 1/4 tsp turmeric (haldi) 1/2 tsp red chilli powder (lal mirch powder) 1 tbsp butter, softened salt to taste chopped coriander (dhania) method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 180°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 mix crumbled paneer with chopped vegetables, turmeric, chilli powder, salt and coriander. 3 butter the bread slices and pile the paneer mixture on top. 4 arrange in the basket in a single layer. 5 bake at 180°c for 9 minutes until the edges of the bread are crisp and the topping is warmed through.

recipes.title: Kachumber Salad (Cucumber-Tomato Salad)
recipes.search: kachumber salad (cucumber-tomato salad) kachumber salad (cucumber-tomato salad) no-cook — 8 min — serves 4 gluten-free • vegan • no-cook • everyday ingredients 1 cucumber, finely diced 2 tomatoes, finely diced 1 small onion, finely diced 1 tbsp lemon juice 1/4 tsp roasted cumin powder (bhuna jeera powder) salt to taste chopped coriander (dhania) method 1 combine the cucumber, tomatoes and onion in a bowl. 2 toss with lemon juice, roasted cumin powder and salt. 3 garnish with coriander and serve fresh alongside any curry, biryani or grilled dish.

recipes.title: Boondi Raita
recipes.search: boondi raita boondi raita no-cook — 6 min — serves 4 gluten-free • vegetarian • no-cook • everyday ingredients 1.5 cups thick yogurt, whisked 1/2 cup boondi (fried gram flour (besan) balls) 1/4 tsp roasted cumin powder (bhuna jeera powder) pinch of red chilli powder (lal mirch powder) salt to taste chopped coriander (dhania) method 1 soak the boondi in warm water for 5 minutes to soften slightly, then squeeze out excess water. 2 whisk the yogurt with salt until smooth; fold in the boondi. 3 sprinkle with roasted cumin powder, chilli powder and coriander before serving chilled.

recipes.title: Quick Pickled Onions
recipes.search: quick pickled onions quick pickled onions no-cook — 5 min + 20 min rest — makes ~1 cup gluten-free • vegan • no-cook • everyday prep ahead: best made at least 20 minutes ahead so the onions soften and turn pink. ingredients 1 large red onion, thinly sliced 2 tbsp lemon juice or vinegar 1/2 tsp sugar 1/4 tsp salt a pinch of chilli powder (mirch powder) or beetroot juice for colour (optional) method 1 toss the sliced onion with lemon juice, sugar and salt. 2 rest for at least 20 minutes, tossing once or twice, until softened and lightly pink. 3 serve alongside kebabs, tikka, biryani or grilled fish.

recipes.title: Mint-Coriander Chutney
recipes.search: mint-coriander chutney mint-coriander chutney chef magic – whisk/blend — 6 min makes ~1 cup gluten-free • vegan • no-cook ingredients 1 cup mint leaves 1 cup coriander leaves (hara dhania) 1 green chilli (hari mirch) 1 tbsp lemon juice 1/2 tsp roasted cumin powder (bhuna jeera powder) 1 tbsp yogurt (optional, for a milder version) salt to taste water as needed method 1 add all ingredients to chef magic’s jar with a splash of water. 2 select whisk/blend (speed 8–10) and run until smooth, adding a little more water if needed to loosen. 3 serve alongside any air-fried snack, tikka or kebab.

recipes.title: Crispy Paneer Bites (Airfryer Croutons)
recipes.search: crispy paneer bites (airfryer croutons) crispy paneer bites (airfryer croutons) airfryer – fry 200°c 10 min — serves 4 gluten-free • vegetarian • high-protein • everyday ingredients 200g paneer, cut into small cubes 1 tbsp oil 1/2 tsp chilli flakes 1/4 tsp garlic (lehsun) powder salt to taste method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 200°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 toss paneer cubes with oil, chilli flakes, garlic powder and salt. 3 arrange in a single layer in the basket, spaced apart. 4 air-fry at 200°c for 10 minutes, shaking halfway, until golden and crisp at the edges. 5 scatter warm over salads, soups or rice bowls in place of croutons.

recipes.title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
recipes.search: stuffed bell peppers stuffed bell peppers airfryer – bake 180°c 16 min — serves 4 ingredients 4 bell peppers, tops cut & seeded 1 cup cooked rice 1/2 cup boiled corn or peas 1/2 cup grated cheese 1 tsp mixed herbs salt & pepper to taste method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 180°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 mix rice, corn, half the cheese, herbs, salt and pepper. 3 stuff the mixture into the peppers and top with remaining cheese. 4 place upright in the basket. 5 bake at 180°c for 16 minutes until peppers soften and cheese melts.

recipes.title: Baked Vegetable Pulao (one-pot)
recipes.search: baked vegetable pulao (one-pot) baked vegetable pulao (one-pot) airfryer – bake 180°c 28 min — serves 4 prep ahead: soak rice for 20 minutes and drain well before using. ingredients 1.5 cups basmati rice, soaked 20 min 1 cup mixed vegetables (carrot, beans, peas) 2.5 cups hot water or stock 1 tbsp oil or ghee 1 tsp cumin seeds (jeera) 1 bay leaf (tej patta) 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste (adrak-lehsun paste) salt to taste method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 180°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 in an oven-safe dish that fits the basket, heat oil, add cumin and bay leaf. 3 add ginger-garlic paste and vegetables; mix in drained rice and salt. 4 pour in hot water, cover the dish tightly with foil. 5 bake at 180°c for 28 minutes; rest covered for 5 minutes before fluffing. tip: keep the dish covered throughout so the rice steams rather than dries out.

recipes.title: Rajma-Stuffed Baked Potatoes
recipes.search: rajma-stuffed baked potatoes rajma-stuffed baked potatoes airfryer – bake 190°c 38 min — serves 4 ingredients 4 large potatoes 1 cup cooked rajma (kidney beans) in light gravy 1/4 cup grated cheese 2 tbsp butter salt & pepper to taste chopped coriander (dhania) method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 190°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 prick potatoes all over and rub lightly with oil. 3 bake at 190°c for 38 minutes until fork-tender. 4 slice open, fluff the inside, and top with warm rajma, butter and cheese. 5 return to the basket for 4 minutes to melt the cheese; garnish and serve.

recipes.title: Vegetable Au Gratin
recipes.search: vegetable au gratin vegetable au gratin airfryer – bake 180°c 19 min — serves 4 ingredients 2 cups mixed boiled vegetables (broccoli, carrot, beans, cauliflower) 1 tbsp butter 1 tbsp flour 1 cup milk 1/2 cup grated cheese salt & pepper to taste 2 tbsp breadcrumbs method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 180°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 make a white sauce: melt butter, whisk in flour, then milk gradually until thick; season. 3 layer vegetables in an oven-safe dish and pour sauce over. 4 top with cheese and breadcrumbs. 5 bake at 180°c for 19 minutes until bubbling and golden on top.

recipes.title: Crispy Sweet Potato Fries
recipes.search: crispy sweet potato fries crispy sweet potato fries airfryer – fry 200°c 17 min — serves 4 ingredients 2 large sweet potatoes, cut into fries 1 tbsp oil 1 tbsp cornflour 1/2 tsp paprika salt to taste method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 200°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 toss sweet potato fries with cornflour first to help crisping, then with oil, paprika and salt. 3 arrange in a single layer in the basket. 4 air-fry at 200°c for 17 minutes, shaking every 5 minutes, until crisp at the edges.

recipes.title: Garlic Parmesan Brussels Sprouts
recipes.search: garlic parmesan brussels sprouts garlic parmesan brussels sprouts airfryer – roast 190°c 14 min — serves 4 ingredients 400g brussels sprouts, halved 1 tbsp oil 2 cloves garlic (lehsun), minced 2 tbsp grated parmesan (or any hard cheese) salt & pepper to taste method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 190°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 toss halved sprouts with oil, garlic, salt and pepper. 3 arrange cut-side down in the basket. 4 roast at 190°c for 14 minutes, shaking halfway, until edges are crisp and charred. 5 toss with parmesan while hot and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Crispy Panko Asparagus
recipes.search: crispy panko asparagus crispy panko asparagus airfryer – bake 190°c 9 min — serves 3 ingredients 1 bunch asparagus, trimmed 1 egg, beaten 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs 2 tbsp grated parmesan salt & pepper to taste oil spray method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 190°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 dip asparagus spears in beaten egg, then coat in panko mixed with parmesan, salt and pepper. 3 spray with oil and arrange in a single layer in the basket. 4 bake at 190°c for 9 minutes until golden and crisp, turning once.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Baked Potatoes
recipes.search: air fryer baked potatoes air fryer baked potatoes airfryer – bake 200°c 38 min — serves 4 ingredients 4 medium potatoes 1 tbsp oil 1 tsp salt butter, sour cream & chives to serve method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 200°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 prick potatoes all over with a fork; rub with oil and salt. 3 place directly in the basket. 4 bake at 200°c for 38 minutes until a knife slides in easily. 5 split open and top with butter, sour cream and chives.

recipes.title: Paneer Steaks with Herb Butter
recipes.search: paneer steaks with herb butter paneer steaks with herb butter airfryer – grill 200°c 12 min — serves 2 gluten-free • vegetarian • high-protein • everyday prep ahead: press paneer between paper towels for 10 minutes to remove excess moisture before marinating. ingredients 300g paneer, cut into 4 thick slabs 1 tbsp oil 1/2 tsp smoked paprika 1/2 tsp garlic (lehsun) powder salt & pepper to taste 2 tbsp butter, softened 1 tbsp chopped mixed herbs (parsley, chives) 1/2 clove garlic (lehsun), minced method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 200°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 rub paneer slabs with oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper. 3 mix softened butter with herbs and minced garlic to make a herb butter. 4 arrange paneer in a single layer in the basket. 5 grill at 200°c for 12 minutes, flipping halfway, until edges are golden and lightly charred. 6 top each steak with a spoon of herb butter while hot and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Eggless Chocolate Mug-Style Cake
recipes.search: eggless chocolate mug-style cake eggless chocolate mug-style cake airfryer – bake 160°c 21 min (small cake) — serves 4 ingredients 1 cup flour 1/3 cup cocoa powder 3/4 cup sugar 1/2 tsp baking soda 1/2 cup milk 1/4 cup oil 1/2 tsp vanilla extract 1/2 tsp vinegar method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 160°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 whisk all dry ingredients together in a bowl. 3 add milk, oil, vanilla and vinegar; mix until smooth and lump-free. 4 pour into a greased oven-safe pan that fits the basket. 5 bake at 160°c for 21 minutes; check with a toothpick before removing. tip: cover the pan loosely with foil for the first 10 minutes to stop the top browning too fast.

recipes.title: Classic Vanilla Cake
recipes.search: classic vanilla cake classic vanilla cake airfryer – bake 160°c 25 min — serves 6 vegetarian • everyday ingredients 1.5 cups all-purpose flour 1 cup sugar 1 tsp baking powder 1/4 tsp salt 1/2 cup butter, softened 3/4 cup milk 1 tsp vanilla extract 2 eggs (or see tip for eggless option) method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 160°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 whisk the flour, baking powder and salt together in a bowl. 3 in a separate bowl, cream the butter and sugar until light and fluffy, then beat in the eggs one at a time, followed by the vanilla. 4 fold in the dry ingredients alternately with the milk, mixing gently until just combined and smooth. 5 pour into a greased oven-safe pan that fits the basket. 6 bake at 160°c for 22–25 minutes, until a toothpick inserted in the centre comes out clean. 7 cool in the pan for 10 minutes before turning out onto a rack to cool completely. tip: for an eggless version, swap the eggs for 1/2 cup thick yogurt whisked with 1/4 tsp baking soda — the texture stays just as soft.

recipes.title: Classic Sponge Cake
recipes.search: classic sponge cake classic sponge cake airfryer – bake 160°c 20 min — serves 6 vegetarian • everyday ingredients 4 eggs, at room temperature 1 cup sugar 1 cup all-purpose flour 1/2 tsp baking powder 1 tsp vanilla extract 2 tbsp melted butter, cooled method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 160°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 whisk the eggs and sugar together for 6–8 minutes until pale, thick and tripled in volume — this whipped air is what makes the sponge light. 3 sift the flour and baking powder together, then gently fold into the egg mixture in two batches, taking care not to knock out the air. 4 fold in the vanilla and melted butter until just combined. 5 pour into a greased oven-safe pan that fits the basket. 6 bake at 160°c for 18–20 minutes, until golden and springy to the touch. 7 cool in the pan for 5 minutes before turning out onto a rack to cool completely. tip: don't skip the long whisking time in step 2 — a properly whipped egg-sugar mixture is the only leavening this cake needs.

recipes.title: Marble Cake (Vanilla-Chocolate Swirl)
recipes.search: marble cake (vanilla-chocolate swirl) marble cake (vanilla-chocolate swirl) airfryer – bake 160°c 26 min — serves 6 vegetarian • everyday ingredients 1.5 cups all-purpose flour 1 cup sugar 1 tsp baking powder 1/4 tsp salt 1/2 cup butter, softened 3/4 cup milk 1 tsp vanilla extract 2 eggs 2 tbsp cocoa powder 2 tbsp milk (extra, for the cocoa batter) method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 160°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 whisk the flour, baking powder and salt together in a bowl. 3 cream the butter and sugar until light and fluffy, then beat in the eggs one at a time, followed by the vanilla. 4 fold in the dry ingredients alternately with the milk, mixing until just combined and smooth. 5 divide the batter in half. whisk the cocoa powder and extra milk into one half until evenly coloured. 6 spoon dollops of vanilla and chocolate batter alternately into a greased oven-safe pan, then swirl gently with a knife or skewer to create a marbled pattern. 7 bake at 160°c for 24–26 minutes, until a toothpick inserted in the centre comes out clean. 8 cool in the pan for 10 minutes before turning out onto a rack to cool completely. tip: just 3–4 swirls with the knife gives the best marbling — over-swirling blends the two batters together and you lose the pattern.

recipes.title: Butter Cookies
recipes.search: butter cookies butter cookies airfryer – bake 160°c 11 min makes ~20 ingredients 1 cup butter, softened 3/4 cup powdered sugar 2 cups flour 1/2 tsp vanilla extract pinch of salt method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 160°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. 3 fold in flour, vanilla and salt to form a soft dough. 4 shape into small discs and place on parchment paper inside the basket, spaced apart. 5 bake at 160°c for 11 minutes until edges turn golden. cool before serving.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
recipes.search: banana bread banana bread airfryer – bake 160°c 38 min — serves 7 ingredients 3 ripe bananas, mashed 1/3 cup melted butter 3/4 cup sugar 1 egg (or flax egg) 1 tsp vanilla extract 1 tsp baking soda pinch of salt 1.5 cups flour method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 160°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 mix mashed banana with melted butter, sugar, egg and vanilla. 3 fold in baking soda, salt and flour until just combined. 4 pour batter into a small greased loaf pan that fits the basket. 5 bake at 160°c for 38 minutes, covering loosely with foil after 20 minutes if browning too fast. 6 cool for 10 minutes before slicing.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Apple Crisps
recipes.search: cinnamon apple crisps cinnamon apple crisps airfryer – bake 150°c 22 min — serves 2 ingredients 2 apples, thinly sliced (core removed) 1/2 tsp cinnamon (dalchini) powder 1 tsp sugar (optional) method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 150°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 toss apple slices with cinnamon and sugar. 3 arrange in a single layer in the basket, without overlapping. 4 bake at 150°c for 22 minutes, flipping halfway, until dry and lightly golden. 5 cool completely — they crisp up further as they cool. tip: slice apples as thinly and evenly as possible for even crisping.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Doughnuts
recipes.search: air fryer doughnuts air fryer doughnuts airfryer – bake 170°c 9 min makes 6 ingredients 1.5 cups flour 2 tsp baking powder 1/4 cup sugar 1/2 tsp cinnamon (dalchini) 1/2 cup milk 1 egg 2 tbsp melted butter extra butter and cinnamon (dalchini)-sugar for coating method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 170°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 mix flour, baking powder, sugar and cinnamon in a bowl. 3 whisk in milk, egg and melted butter to form a soft dough. 4 shape into small rings or balls and place in the basket, spaced apart. 5 bake at 170°c for 9 minutes until golden; brush with butter and roll in cinnamon-sugar while warm.

recipes.title: Mini Cheesecakes
recipes.search: mini cheesecakes mini cheesecakes airfryer – bake 150°c 16 min makes 6 ingredients 1 cup crushed digestive biscuits 3 tbsp melted butter 200g cream cheese, softened 1/4 cup sugar 1 egg 1/2 tsp vanilla extract method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 150°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 mix crushed biscuits with melted butter; press into small muffin cups or ramekins as a base. 3 beat cream cheese, sugar, egg and vanilla until smooth; pour over the base. 4 place cups in the basket. 5 bake at 150°c for 16 minutes until just set with a slight wobble in the centre. chill before serving. tip: baking low and slow prevents cracks on top.

recipes.title: Whole Wheat Pizza
recipes.search: whole wheat pizza whole wheat pizza airfryer – bake 190°c 11 min — serves 2 ingredients 1 whole wheat pizza base or flatbread 3 tbsp pizza sauce 1/2 cup grated mozzarella toppings of choice (capsicum, onion, corn, olives) 1/2 tsp oregano & chilli flakes method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 190°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 spread sauce evenly over the base. 3 add cheese and toppings; sprinkle oregano and chilli flakes. 4 place carefully in the basket. 5 bake at 190°c for 11 minutes until the cheese melts and the base is crisp.

recipes.title: Granola Bars
recipes.search: granola bars granola bars airfryer – bake 150°c 16 min makes 8 bars ingredients 1.5 cups rolled oats 1/3 cup honey or maple syrup 1/4 cup peanut butter 1/4 cup mixed nuts & seeds, chopped 1/4 cup dried fruit, chopped pinch of salt method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 150°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 warm honey and peanut butter together until runny; mix with oats, nuts, seeds, dried fruit and salt. 3 press firmly into a small greased pan that fits the basket. 4 bake at 150°c for 16 minutes until edges turn golden. 5 cool completely in the pan before slicing into bars — this helps them hold together.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.search: air fryer chocolate chip cookies air fryer chocolate chip cookies airfryer – bake 160°c 9 min makes ~10 ingredients 1 cup flour 1/2 cup butter, softened 1/2 cup brown sugar 1 egg 1/2 tsp vanilla extract 1/2 tsp baking soda pinch of salt 1/2 cup chocolate chips method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 160°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 cream butter and sugar until fluffy; beat in egg and vanilla. 3 fold in flour, baking soda, salt and chocolate chips to form a soft dough. 4 scoop into balls and place on parchment in the basket, spaced well apart. 5 bake at 160°c for 9 minutes until edges are golden but centres look slightly underdone; cool on the tray before moving.

recipes.title: Quick Cinnamon Rolls
recipes.search: quick cinnamon rolls quick cinnamon rolls airfryer – bake 160°c 9 min makes 6 ingredients 1 tube (6-piece) refrigerated cinnamon (dalchini) roll dough with icing (or use the dinner roll dough recipe and add cinnamon (dalchini)-sugar filling) method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 160°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 separate cinnamon rolls and arrange in a single layer in a greased pan that fits the basket, leaving space to expand. 3 bake at 160°c for 9 minutes until puffed and golden, checking from 7 minutes. 4 cool for 2 minutes, then top with the included icing before serving.

recipes.title: Paneer Kalakand (Airfryer-Set Milk Fudge)
recipes.search: paneer kalakand (airfryer-set milk fudge) paneer kalakand (airfryer-set milk fudge) chef magic (cook mixture) → airfryer (set & lightly brown) 150°c — cook 20 min + set 12 min — makes ~16 pieces gluten-free • vegetarian prep ahead: use fresh, soft paneer — firmer paneer won’t break down into the right fudgy texture. ingredients 300g paneer, crumbled 1 cup milk powder 1 cup condensed milk 2 tbsp ghee 1/2 tsp cardamom powder (elaichi powder) a few chopped pistachios, to garnish method 1 preheat: when you reach the airfryer step, preheat it to 150°c for 4 minutes before adding the food. 2 add ghee and crumbled paneer to chef magic’s jar; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) and cook for 5 minutes until the paneer softens. 3 add milk powder and condensed milk; continue on sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) for 15 minutes, stirring, until the mixture thickens and starts to pull away from the sides. 4 stir in cardamom powder, then spread the mixture into a greased shallow dish that fits the airfryer basket. 5 bake at 150°c for 12 minutes until the top looks just set and lightly golden at the edges. 6 sprinkle with pistachios, cool completely, then chill for 1 hour before cutting into squares. tip: kalakand firms up as it cools — it will look softer than expected straight out of the airfryer.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Gulab Jamun
recipes.search: air fryer gulab jamun air fryer gulab jamun chef magic (knead & syrup) → airfryer (fry) 180°c knead 5 min + fry 12 min makes ~12 prep ahead: rest the dough for 10 minutes before shaping so the khoya hydrates and the balls don’t crack. ingredients 1 cup milk powder (khoya substitute) 3 tbsp flour 1/4 tsp baking soda 2 tbsp milk 2 tbsp ghee, melted, plus extra for brushing 1.5 cups sugar 1.5 cups water 3–4 green cardamom (elaichi) pods, crushed a few saffron (kesar) strands (optional) method 1 preheat: when you reach the airfryer step, preheat it to 180°c for 4 minutes before adding the food. 2 in chef magic, add milk powder, flour and baking soda; select knead (speed 2–3, no heat), adding milk and melted ghee gradually until a smooth, crack-free dough forms. rest 10 minutes. 3 meanwhile, add sugar, water and crushed cardamom to a clean jar; select boil (speed 1–2, 100°c) and simmer for 8 minutes until a light, one-string syrup forms. keep warm. 4 divide the dough into 12 smooth balls, brushing your palms with ghee to prevent cracking. 5 brush the balls generously with ghee and arrange in the basket, spaced apart. 6 air-fry at 180°c for 12 minutes, turning every 4 minutes, until deep golden-brown all over. 7 drop the hot fried balls straight into the warm syrup and soak for at least 30 minutes before serving. tip: a crack in the dough ball means it will split open in the syrup — smooth every ball fully before frying.

recipes.title: Coconut Ladoo (No-Cook Finish)
recipes.search: coconut ladoo (no-cook finish) coconut ladoo (no-cook finish) chef magic – sauté auto 12 min makes ~14 gluten-free • vegetarian • no-cook finish ingredients 2 cups desiccated coconut, plus extra for rolling 1 cup condensed milk 1/2 tsp cardamom powder (elaichi powder) 1 tbsp ghee a few chopped pistachios (optional) method 1 add ghee and desiccated coconut to the jar; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) and roast for 4 minutes until fragrant, not browned. 2 add the condensed milk and cardamom powder; continue on sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) for 6 minutes, stirring, until the mixture thickens and starts to pull away from the sides. 3 cool for 10 minutes until just warm enough to handle. 4 shape into small balls, roll in extra desiccated coconut, and top with a pistachio sliver. 5 cool completely before storing in an airtight container. tip: the mixture firms up a lot as it cools — shape the ladoos while still slightly warm.

recipes.title: Rasgulla (Spongy Cottage Cheese Balls in Syrup)
recipes.search: rasgulla (spongy cottage cheese balls in syrup) rasgulla (spongy cottage cheese balls in syrup) chef magic – boil auto 26 min makes ~10 vegetarian • bengali prep ahead: use paneer made from full-fat milk curdled fresh that day — the fresher the paneer, the spongier the rasgulla. ingredients 1 litre full-fat milk 2 tbsp lemon juice or vinegar 1.5 cups sugar 4 cups water 1/2 tsp cardamom powder (elaichi powder) 1 tbsp flour or semolina (for binding) method 1 bring milk to a boil in a separate pan, add lemon juice, and stir until it curdles into paneer and clear whey. strain, rinse under cold water, and hang in muslin for 30 minutes. 2 knead the paneer with flour on a smooth surface for 8–10 minutes until soft and completely smooth, with no grains left. 3 divide into 10 smooth, crack-free balls. 4 add sugar, water and cardamom to chef magic’s jar; select boil (speed 1–2, 100°c) until the syrup is bubbling well. 5 gently slide in the paneer balls; continue on boil (speed 1–2, 100°c), covered, for 15 minutes — they will roughly double in size. 6 cool in the syrup for at least 1 hour before serving chilled. tip: boiling hard and keeping the jar covered is what makes the rasgullas puff up — resist peeking too often.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Chocolate Lava Cakes
recipes.search: air fryer chocolate lava cakes air fryer chocolate lava cakes airfryer – bake 180°c 11 min makes 4 prep ahead: chill the filled ramekins for 15 minutes before baking so the centres stay molten. ingredients 1/2 cup dark chocolate, chopped 1/2 cup butter 2 eggs 2 egg yolks 1/3 cup sugar 1/4 cup flour pinch of salt butter & cocoa powder, for greasing ramekins method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 180°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 melt the chocolate and butter together (double boiler or short bursts in a microwave); cool slightly. 3 whisk eggs, egg yolks and sugar until pale and thick, then fold in the melted chocolate mixture. 4 fold in flour and salt until just combined. 5 divide between 4 greased, cocoa-dusted ramekins that fit the basket; chill 15 minutes. 6 bake at 180°c for 11 minutes until the sides are set but the centre still jiggles slightly. 7 rest 1 minute, then invert onto plates and serve immediately while the centre is molten. tip: every airfryer runs slightly differently — start checking at 9 minutes the first time you make these.

recipes.title: Besan Ladoo
recipes.search: besan ladoo besan ladoo chef magic – sauté auto 20 min makes ~14 vegetarian • everyday ingredients 2 cups besan (gram flour (besan)) 3/4 cup ghee 3/4 cup powdered sugar 1/2 tsp cardamom powder (elaichi powder) 10 cashews, chopped (optional) method 1 add ghee to the jar; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) and add besan once melted. 2 continue on sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) for 16 minutes, stirring frequently, until the besan turns deep golden and gives off a rich, nutty aroma. 3 stir in chopped cashews for the last 2 minutes. 4 cool for 10 minutes, then mix in the powdered sugar and cardamom powder — adding sugar while too hot will melt it. 5 shape into small balls while the mixture is still warm enough to hold together. 6 cool completely before storing in an airtight container. tip: besan scorches quickly once it starts to turn golden — stay close to the jar for the last few minutes.

recipes.title: Rasmalai (Paneer Dumplings in Saffron Milk)
recipes.search: rasmalai (paneer dumplings in saffron milk) rasmalai (paneer dumplings in saffron milk) chef magic – boil then sauté auto 34 min makes ~10 prep ahead: use paneer made from full-fat milk curdled fresh that day, same as for rasgulla — the fresher the paneer, the ingredients 1 litre full-fat milk 2 tbsp lemon juice or vinegar 1 cup sugar 4 cups water 1 tbsp flour or semolina 2 cups milk (for the rabri) 3 tbsp sugar (for the rabri) a few saffron (kesar) strands 1/2 tsp cardamom powder (elaichi powder) chopped pistachios & almonds to garnish method 1 bring milk to a boil in a separate pan, add lemon juice, and stir until it curdles into paneer and clear whey. strain, rinse under cold water, and hang in muslin for 30 minutes. 2 knead the paneer with flour on a smooth surface for 8–10 minutes until soft and completely smooth, with no grains left; divide into 10 smooth balls and flatten slightly. 3 add sugar and water to chef magic’s jar; select boil (speed 1–2, 100°c) until the syrup is bubbling well. 4 gently slide in the paneer discs; continue on boil (speed 1–2, 100°c), covered, for 15 minutes until they roughly double in size. cool in the syrup. 5 meanwhile, in a clean jar, add the second batch of milk, sugar and saffron; select sauté (speed 1–2, ~100–110°c) and simmer for 12 minutes, stirring occasionally, until reduced and slightly thickened. stir in cardamom powder. 6 squeeze the cooled discs gently to remove excess syrup, then soak them in the warm saffron milk for at least 1 hour. garnish with pistachios and almonds before serving chilled. tip: rasmalai discs should be flattened, not round like rasgulla — a flatter shape soaks up the milk better.

recipes.title: Semiya (Vermicelli) Kheer
recipes.search: semiya (vermicelli) kheer semiya (vermicelli) kheer chef magic – sauté + boil auto 22 min — serves 4 ingredients 1 cup vermicelli 3 cups milk 3 tbsp sugar 1 tbsp ghee 10 cashews & raisins 1/4 tsp cardamom powder (elaichi powder) method 1 add ghee, cashews and raisins to the jar; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) until golden. 2 add vermicelli and sauté 2 minutes until lightly toasted. 3 pour in milk and sugar; select boil (speed 1–2, 100°c) and cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened. 4 stir in cardamom powder and serve warm or chilled.

recipes.title: Sooji Halwa (Rava Kesari)
recipes.search: sooji halwa (rava kesari) sooji halwa (rava kesari) chef magic – sauté + boil auto 16 min — serves 4 ingredients 1 cup sooji (semolina) 1/2 cup sugar 3 tbsp ghee 2 cups water 10 cashews & raisins 1/4 tsp cardamom powder (elaichi powder) a few saffron (kesar) strands (optional) method 1 add ghee, cashews and raisins to the jar; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) until golden. 2 add sooji and sauté 4 minutes until fragrant and lightly toasted. 3 add water and sugar; select boil (speed 1–2, 100°c) and cook, stirring, until the mixture thickens and leaves the sides of the jar. 4 stir in cardamom and saffron; serve warm.

recipes.title: Custard (Vanilla or Fruit)
recipes.search: custard (vanilla or fruit) custard (vanilla or fruit) chef magic – boil + whisk auto 11 min — serves 4 ingredients 2.5 cups milk 2 tbsp custard powder 3 tbsp sugar 1/2 cup milk (for the slurry) chopped fruit of choice, to serve method 1 whisk custard powder with the extra cold milk to make a smooth slurry. 2 add the remaining milk and sugar to the jar; select boil (speed 1–2, 100°c). 3 once hot, stir in the custard slurry and continue on boil (speed 1–2, 100°c), stirring, until thickened. 4 cool slightly, pour over chopped fruit and chill before serving.

recipes.title: Kara Prasad (Air Fryer / Chef Magic Adaptation)
recipes.search: kara prasad (air fryer / chef magic adaptation) kara prasad (air fryer / chef magic adaptation) airfryer – bake (heatproof pan) 160°c ~20 min — serves 4–6 ingredients 1 cup whole wheat flour (atta) 1 cup sugar 1 cup ghee 3 cups water 2 tbsp chopped nuts (optional) 2–3 cardamom (elaichi) pods, powdered (optional) method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 160°c for 3 minutes. 2 in a suitable heatproof pan, add the ghee and wheat flour. cook at 160°c for about 8–10 minutes, stirring every 2–3 minutes, until fragrant and evenly roasted. 3 meanwhile, dissolve the sugar in the water and heat until fully dissolved and hot. 4 carefully add the hot sugar-water mixture to the roasted flour and ghee, stirring continuously to prevent lumps. 5 cook at 160°c for another 8–12 minutes, stirring frequently, until the mixture becomes glossy and pulls together. 6 mix in cardamom and nuts if using. rest for 2–3 minutes before serving warm. tip: kara prasad is traditionally prepared on the stovetop; this version is adapted for the airfryer — use a heatproof pan and stir

recipes.title: Payesh (Bengali Rice Pudding)
recipes.search: payesh (bengali rice pudding) payesh (bengali rice pudding) chef magic – boil auto 24 min — serves 4 vegetarian • bengali ingredients 150g paneer, crumbled 4 cups milk 3 tbsp sugar 1 tbsp rice, soaked 20 min 1/4 tsp cardamom powder (elaichi powder) a few saffron (kesar) strands chopped pistachios to garnish method 1 add milk and soaked rice to the jar; select boil (speed 1–2, 100°c) and cook for 15 minutes until the rice is soft and the milk has reduced slightly. 2 add sugar and crumbled paneer; continue on boil (speed 1–2, 100°c) for 6 minutes, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened. 3 stir in cardamom powder and saffron; cool slightly. 4 garnish with pistachios and serve warm or chilled. tip: the payesh thickens further as it cools, so take it off a little runnier than you want the final texture.

recipes.title: Dal Tadka
recipes.search: dal tadka dal tadka chef magic – sauté + boil auto 28 min — serves 4 prep ahead: wash the dal well; soaking for 18 minutes will shorten the boiling time. ingredients 1 cup toor dal, washed 3 cups water 1/2 tsp turmeric (haldi) 1 tomato, chopped 1 onion, chopped 1 tsp cumin seeds (jeera) 2 cloves garlic (lehsun), chopped 1 tbsp ghee/oil salt to taste chopped coriander (dhania) for garnish method 1 add dal, water, turmeric and salt to the jar; select boil (speed 1–2, 100°c) and cook until soft. 2 drain if needed and set the cooked dal aside in a bowl. 3 add ghee, cumin, garlic and onion to the jar; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) until golden. 4 add the tomato and sauté until soft, then stir the cooked dal back in and simmer 4 minutes. garnish with coriander.

recipes.title: Steamed Vegetable Momos
recipes.search: steamed vegetable momos steamed vegetable momos chef magic – steam auto 14 min makes ~15 ingredients 15 momo wrappers 1 cup finely chopped cabbage, carrot, spring onion 1 tsp soy sauce 1/2 tsp ginger-garlic paste (adrak-lehsun paste) salt & pepper to taste water for the steamer base method 1 mix vegetables with soy sauce, ginger-garlic paste, salt and pepper for the filling. 2 fill wrappers with the mixture and pleat closed. 3 add water to the jar, fit the steamer tray with momos on top. 4 select steam (100°c steam, paddle off) and cook for 14 minutes until wrappers turn glossy.

recipes.title: Tomato Soup
recipes.search: tomato soup tomato soup chef magic – boil + whisk auto 16 min — serves 4 ingredients 4 large tomatoes, chopped 1 small onion, chopped 2 cloves garlic (lehsun) 1 cup water or vegetable stock 1 tsp sugar salt & pepper to taste 1 tbsp butter (optional) method 1 add tomatoes, onion, garlic, water, sugar, salt and pepper to the jar. 2 select boil (speed 1–2, 100°c) and cook until tomatoes are fully soft. 3 select whisk/blend (speed 8–10) to purée until smooth. 4 stir in butter if using and serve hot.

recipes.title: Paneer Butter Masala
recipes.search: paneer butter masala paneer butter masala chef magic – sauté auto 22 min — serves 4 ingredients 200g paneer, cubed 2 tomatoes, chopped 1 onion, chopped 10 cashews 1 tbsp butter 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste (adrak-lehsun paste) 1 tsp garam masala 1/2 tsp red chilli powder (lal mirch powder) 2 tbsp cream salt to taste method 1 add butter, onion, tomatoes, cashews and ginger-garlic paste to the jar; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) until soft. 2 select whisk/blend (speed 8–10) briefly to purée into a smooth gravy base. 3 select sauté (speed 1–2, ~100–110°c) again, stir in garam masala, chilli powder and salt, and simmer 5 minutes. 4 add paneer cubes and cream; sauté gently 4 minutes until warmed through.

recipes.title: Vegetable Khichdi
recipes.search: vegetable khichdi vegetable khichdi chef magic – sauté + boil auto 28 min — serves 4 prep ahead: wash and soak rice and dal together for 18 minutes for a softer, quicker-cooking khichdi. ingredients 1/2 cup rice 1/2 cup moong dal 1 cup mixed vegetables, chopped 1 tsp cumin seeds (jeera) 1/2 tsp turmeric (haldi) 1 tbsp ghee 3.5 cups water salt to taste method 1 add ghee and cumin seeds to the jar; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) for 2 minutes until fragrant. 2 add rice, dal, vegetables, turmeric and salt; sauté briefly to combine. 3 pour in water, select boil (speed 1–2, 100°c) and cook until rice and dal are soft and mushy. 4 stir well and serve hot with a dollop of ghee.

recipes.title: Fresh Mango Smoothie
recipes.search: fresh mango smoothie fresh mango smoothie chef magic – whisk/blend — 2 min — serves 2 ingredients 1 cup ripe mango, chopped 1 cup milk or yogurt 1 tbsp honey (optional) 4 ice cubes method 1 add all ingredients to the jar. 2 select whisk/blend (speed 8–10) and run until smooth and frothy. 3 pour into glasses and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Vegetable Poha
recipes.search: vegetable poha vegetable poha chef magic – sauté auto 14 min — serves 3 prep ahead: rinse poha (flattened rice) briefly in a sieve under running water and let it soften for 5 minutes before adding. ingredients 2 cups thick poha, rinsed 1 small onion, chopped 1 small potato, diced 1 tsp mustard seeds (rai) 9 curry leaves (kadi patta) 1/4 tsp turmeric (haldi) 1 tbsp oil salt to taste lemon juice & chopped coriander (dhania) to finish method 1 add oil, mustard seeds and curry leaves to the jar; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) until seeds splutter. 2 add onion and potato; sauté until soft. 3 add turmeric and salt, then fold in the softened poha; sauté gently 4 minutes to heat through. 4 finish with lemon juice and coriander before serving.

recipes.title: Stuffed Kachori
recipes.search: stuffed kachori stuffed kachori chef magic (knead) → airfryer (fry) 190°c knead 5 min + fry 16 min makes ~10 ingredients 2 cups flour 3 tbsp oil (for dough) water as needed 1 cup boiled moong dal, mashed 1 tsp fennel seeds (saunf) 1/2 tsp red chilli powder (lal mirch powder) 1/2 tsp garam masala salt to taste oil spray method 1 preheat: when you reach the airfryer step, preheat it to 190°c for 4 minutes before adding the food. 2 in chef magic, add flour, oil and a pinch of salt; select knead (speed 2–3, no heat), adding water gradually until a firm dough forms. rest 15 minutes. 3 mix mashed moong dal with fennel, chilli powder, garam masala and salt for the filling. 4 roll dough into small discs, stuff with filling, and seal into balls; flatten slightly. 5 spray lightly with oil and air-fry in the airfryer at 190°c for 16 minutes, turning once, until golden and flaky.

recipes.title: Soft Dinner Rolls
recipes.search: soft dinner rolls soft dinner rolls chef magic (knead) → airfryer (bake) 180°c — knead 5 min + rest 45 min + bake 14 min — makes 8 rolls ingredients 2.5 cups flour 1 tsp instant yeast 2 tbsp sugar 3/4 cup warm milk (105–110°f / 40–43°c) 2 tbsp melted butter 1 egg 1/2 tsp salt extra butter for brushing method 1 preheat: when you reach the airfryer step, preheat it to 180°c for 4 minutes before adding the food. 2 in chef magic, mix warm milk (105–110°f / 40–43°c — warm to the touch, not hot), yeast and sugar; rest 5–10 minutes until frothy. 3 add flour, melted butter, egg and salt; select knead (speed 2–3, no heat) until a smooth, soft dough forms. 4 shape into 8 balls, place in a greased pan that fits the basket, and rest covered for 45 minutes until puffy. 5 bake in the airfryer at 180°c for 14 minutes until golden; brush with butter while warm.

recipes.title: Paneer Tikka (marinated & grilled)
recipes.search: paneer tikka (marinated & grilled) paneer tikka (marinated & grilled) chef magic (mix marinade) → airfryer (grill) 200°c marinate 30 min + grill 12 min — serves 4 gluten-free • vegetarian • high-protein • everyday prep ahead: marinate the paneer and vegetables for at least 30 minutes before grilling. ingredients 400g paneer, cubed 1/2 cup thick yogurt 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste (adrak-lehsun paste) 1 tsp red chilli powder (lal mirch powder) 1/2 tsp garam masala 1 tbsp mustard oil (sarson ka tel) bell peppers & onion, cubed salt to taste method 1 preheat: when you reach the airfryer step, preheat it to 200°c for 4 minutes before adding the food. 2 in chef magic, mix yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, chilli powder, garam masala, mustard oil and salt to make the marinade. 3 coat the paneer and vegetables in the marinade and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. 4 skewer or arrange in the airfryer basket. 5 grill at 200°c for 12 minutes, turning once, until charred at the edges. 6 serve with mint chutney and lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Aloo Tikki (Potato Cutlets)
recipes.search: aloo tikki (potato cutlets) aloo tikki (potato cutlets) airfryer or chef magic — pick whichever you have free — 22 min makes ~8 prep ahead: boil and cool potatoes fully (or use leftover boiled potatoes) before mixing — warm potato makes a sticky dough. ingredients 4 medium potatoes, boiled & mashed 2 tbsp cornflour 1 green chilli (hari mirch), chopped 1 tsp ginger (adrak), grated 1/2 tsp roasted cumin powder (bhuna jeera powder) 1/2 tsp garam masala 2 tbsp chopped coriander (dhania) salt to taste oil (for both methods) method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 190°c for 4 minutes before adding the food. 2 mix all ingredients into a firm dough and shape into patties. 3 option a – airfryer: brush or spray both sides lightly with oil, arrange in a single layer in the basket, and air-fry at 190°c for 16 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and crisp. 4 option b – chef magic: add oil to the jar, select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c), and cook the patties, turning occasionally, for 11 minutes until golden on both sides. tip: chef magic’s sauté gives a slightly richer, more traditionally fried crust; the airfryer version uses far less oil.

recipes.title: Bhindi Fry (Crispy Okra)
recipes.search: bhindi fry (crispy okra) bhindi fry (crispy okra) airfryer or chef magic — pick whichever you have free — 16 min — serves 4 prep ahead: wash and dry okra completely before slicing — any moisture makes it slimy instead of crisp. ingredients 300g okra (bhindi), sliced lengthwise 1 tbsp oil 1/2 tsp turmeric (haldi) 1/2 tsp red chilli powder (lal mirch powder) 1/2 tsp amchur (dry mango powder) salt to taste method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 200°c for 4 minutes before adding the food. 2 option a – airfryer: toss okra with oil and all spices, spread in a single layer in the basket, and air-fry at 200°c for 14 minutes, shaking every 5 minutes, until crisp and lightly charred. 3 option b – chef magic: add oil to the jar, select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c), add okra and all spices, and cook, stirring occasionally, for 14 minutes until crisp and no longer sticky.

recipes.title: Roasted Masala Papad
recipes.search: roasted masala papad roasted masala papad airfryer or chef magic — pick whichever you have free — 4 min — serves 4 ingredients 4 papads 1 small onion, finely chopped 1 small tomato, finely chopped 1/2 tsp chaat masala 1 tbsp chopped coriander (dhania) a squeeze of lemon method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 180°c for 4 minutes before adding the food. 2 option a – airfryer: place papads in the basket in a single layer (roast in batches if needed), roast at 180°c for 4 minutes, flipping halfway, until crisp and bubbled. 3 option b – chef magic: select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) with no oil, place a papad flat in the jar, dry-roast 2 minutes per side, pressing gently, until crisp and bubbled; repeat for remaining papads. 4 top with chopped onion, tomato, chaat masala, coriander and lemon juice just before serving.

recipes.title: Vegetable Pakoras
recipes.search: vegetable pakoras vegetable pakoras airfryer or chef magic — pick whichever you have free — 19 min — serves 4 ingredients 2 cups mixed vegetables (onion, potato, spinach), thinly sliced 1 cup besan (gram flour (besan)) 1/2 tsp turmeric (haldi) 1/2 tsp red chilli powder (lal mirch powder) 1/4 tsp ajwain (carom seeds (ajwain)) salt to taste water as needed oil (for both methods) method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 190°c for 4 minutes before adding the food. 2 mix vegetables with besan, spices, salt and just enough water to bind into a thick batter-coating. 3 option a – airfryer: shape into small fritters, spray generously with oil, arrange in the basket, and air-fry at 190°c for 4 minutes, shaking halfway, until golden and crisp. 5 option b – chef magic: add 4 tbsp oil to the jar, select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c), and drop spoonfuls of batter into the hot jar, turning occasionally, for 11 minutes until golden and crisp on all sides. tip: the airfryer version uses roughly a third of the oil of the traditional chef magic sauté version.

recipes.title: Paneer 65
recipes.search: paneer 65 paneer 65 airfryer or chef magic — pick whichever you have free — marinate 30 min + cook 14 min — serves 4 gluten-free • vegetarian • high-protein • everyday prep ahead: marinate the paneer for at least 30 minutes for the best flavour. ingredients 400g paneer, cubed 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste (adrak-lehsun paste) 1 tsp red chilli powder (lal mirch powder) 1/2 tsp turmeric (haldi) 2 tbsp curd 2 tbsp cornflour 1 tbsp rice flour salt to taste curry leaves (kadi patta) & 1 green chilli (hari mirch), slit, for tempering 1 tbsp oil method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 200°c for 4 minutes before adding the food. 2 marinate paneer with ginger-garlic paste, spices, curd, cornflour and rice flour for 30 minutes. 3 option a – airfryer: spray with oil, arrange in the basket in a single layer, air-fry at 200°c for 12 minutes, shaking halfway, until crisp and golden; toss with a quick curry leaf tempering before serving. 4 option b – chef magic: add oil to the jar, select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c), add curry leaves and green chilli briefly, then add marinated paneer and cook, stirring gently, for 10 minutes until crisp outside.

recipes.title: Everyday Toor Dal (Simple Daily Dal)
recipes.search: everyday toor dal (simple daily dal) everyday toor dal (simple daily dal) chef magic – sauté + boil auto 22 min — serves 4 gluten-free • high-protein • vegetarian • everyday ingredients 1 cup toor dal, washed 3 cups water 1/2 tsp turmeric (haldi) 1 tsp cumin seeds (jeera) 1 dried red chilli (lal mirch) 1 tbsp ghee salt to taste chopped coriander (dhania) method 1 add dal, water, turmeric and salt to the jar; select boil (speed 1–2, 100°c) and cook until fully soft. 2 add ghee, cumin seeds and dried red chilli directly into the cooked dal; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) for 2 minutes to temper. 3 stir well and garnish with coriander before serving.

recipes.title: Simple Mixed Vegetable Sabzi
recipes.search: simple mixed vegetable sabzi simple mixed vegetable sabzi chef magic – sauté auto 16 min — serves 4 gluten-free • vegan • low-oil • everyday ingredients 2 cups mixed vegetables, chopped (beans, carrot, potato) 1 tsp mustard seeds (rai) 9 curry leaves (kadi patta) 1/2 tsp turmeric (haldi) 1/2 tsp red chilli powder (lal mirch powder) 1 tbsp oil salt to taste method 1 add oil, mustard seeds and curry leaves to the jar; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) until seeds splutter. 2 add vegetables, turmeric, chilli powder and salt. 3 continue on sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) for 14 minutes, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are tender.

recipes.title: Curd Rice (Thayir Sadam)
recipes.search: curd rice (thayir sadam) curd rice (thayir sadam) chef magic – boil then mix auto 15 min + cooling — serves 4 gluten-free • gut-friendly • probiotic • vegetarian • everyday prep ahead: cook rice a little softer than usual — curd rice works best with slightly mushy rice. ingredients 1 cup rice 2.5 cups water 1.5 cups fresh curd (yogurt) 1/2 cup milk 1 tsp mustard seeds (rai) 1 dried red chilli (lal mirch) 9 curry leaves (kadi patta) 1 tsp oil salt to taste grated ginger (adrak) or pomegranate, to garnish (optional) method 1 add rice and water to the jar; select boil (speed 1–2, 100°c) and cook until soft and fully done. 2 let the rice cool to room temperature, then mash lightly and mix in curd, milk and salt. 3 make a quick tempering with oil, mustard seeds, dried chilli and curry leaves and stir it in. 4 chill before serving; garnish with ginger or pomegranate if using. tip: never mix curd into hot rice — it can split and turn watery. always cool the rice first.

recipes.title: Vegetable Quinoa Pulao
recipes.search: vegetable quinoa pulao vegetable quinoa pulao chef magic – sauté + boil auto 21 min — serves 3 gluten-free • high-protein • vegan • healthy prep ahead: rinse quinoa well under running water until the water runs clear, to remove its natural bitterness. ingredients 1 cup quinoa, rinsed 1 cup mixed vegetables, chopped 1 small onion, chopped 1 tsp cumin seeds (jeera) 1 tbsp oil 1.75 cups water salt to taste method 1 add oil and cumin seeds to the jar; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) until fragrant. 2 add onion and vegetables; sauté 4 minutes. 3 add quinoa, water and salt; select boil (speed 1–2, 100°c) and cook until the water is absorbed and quinoa is fluffy. 4 fluff with a fork before serving.

recipes.title: Ragi (Finger Millet) Vegetable Chilla
recipes.search: ragi (finger millet) vegetable chilla ragi (finger millet) vegetable chilla airfryer – fry (griddle-style) 180°c 11 min makes ~6 gluten-free • high-fibre • vegetarian • everyday prep ahead: rest the batter for 12 minutes before cooking so the ragi flour hydrates fully. ingredients 1 cup ragi (finger millet) flour 1/4 cup grated carrot & chopped onion 1 green chilli (hari mirch), chopped 1/4 tsp cumin seeds (jeera) salt to taste water to make a thin batter oil for cooking method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 180°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 mix ragi flour, vegetables, cumin, chilli and salt; whisk in water to a thin, pourable batter. rest 12 minutes. 3 brush the airfryer’s baking pan or a flat oven-safe dish with oil and preheat. 4 pour a thin layer of batter, spray the top lightly with oil, and cook at 180°c for 6 minutes per side until firm and lightly browned. 5 repeat with the remaining batter. tip: no air fryer pan handy? this batter also cooks well the traditional way on a hot tawa.

recipes.title: Sprouted Moong Salad
recipes.search: sprouted moong salad sprouted moong salad no-cook (chef magic steam optional) — 10 min — serves 2 gluten-free • vegan • high-fibre • gut-friendly • no-cook prep ahead: sprout moong beans 2 days ahead: soak overnight, then keep in a damp cloth until they sprout. ingredients 2 cups sprouted moong beans 1 small onion, finely chopped 1 tomato, chopped 1/2 cucumber, chopped 1 tbsp lemon juice 1/2 tsp chaat masala salt to taste chopped coriander (dhania) method 1 if you prefer them slightly cooked, steam the sprouts in chef magic using the steamer tray for 4 minutes; otherwise use raw. 2 toss sprouts with onion, tomato, cucumber, lemon juice, chaat masala and salt. 3 garnish with coriander and serve fresh.

recipes.title: Homemade Buttermilk (Masala Chaas)
recipes.search: homemade buttermilk (masala chaas) homemade buttermilk (masala chaas) chef magic – whisk/blend — 4 min — serves 2 gluten-free • gut-friendly • probiotic • vegetarian • no-cook ingredients 1 cup fresh curd (yogurt) 2 cups chilled water 1/4 tsp roasted cumin powder (bhuna jeera powder) salt to taste a few mint or coriander leaves (hara dhania) 1 green chilli (optional) method 1 add all ingredients to the jar. 2 select whisk/blend (speed 8–10) and run until smooth and frothy. 3 pour into glasses over ice and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Vegetable Oats Khichdi
recipes.search: vegetable oats khichdi vegetable oats khichdi chef magic – sauté + boil auto 19 min — serves 3 high-fibre • vegetarian • healthy • everyday ingredients 1 cup rolled oats 1 cup mixed vegetables, chopped 1 tsp mustard seeds (rai) 9 curry leaves (kadi patta) 1/2 tsp turmeric (haldi) 1 tbsp oil 2.5 cups water salt to taste method 1 add oil, mustard seeds and curry leaves to the jar; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) until seeds splutter. 2 add vegetables and turmeric; sauté 2 minutes. 3 add oats, water and salt; select boil (speed 1–2, 100°c) and cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened and porridge-like. tip: use certified gluten-free oats if you need this dish to be strictly gluten-free.

recipes.title: Baked Vegetable & Egg Muffins (High-Protein)
recipes.search: baked vegetable & egg muffins (high-protein) baked vegetable & egg muffins (high-protein) airfryer – bake 160°c 13 min makes 6 gluten-free • high-protein • low-carb • everyday ingredients 6 eggs 1/4 cup chopped spinach 1/4 cup chopped bell pepper 2 tbsp grated cheese salt & pepper to taste oil spray for the cups method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 160°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 whisk eggs with salt and pepper; stir in spinach, bell pepper and cheese. 3 pour into greased muffin cups that fit the basket. 4 bake at 160°c for 13 minutes until set and lightly golden. 5 cool slightly before removing; refrigerate leftovers for up to 3 days.

recipes.title: Jeera Rice (Cumin Rice)
recipes.search: jeera rice (cumin rice) jeera rice (cumin rice) chef magic – sauté + boil auto 18 min — serves 4 gluten-free • vegan • everyday prep ahead: soak the rice for 15 minutes and drain well before using, for fluffier grains. ingredients 1.5 cups basmati rice, soaked 15 min 1.5 tbsp ghee or oil 1.5 tsp cumin seeds (jeera) 1 bay leaf (tej patta) 2.5 cups water salt to taste chopped coriander (dhania) to garnish method 1 add ghee, cumin seeds and bay leaf to the jar; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) until the seeds splutter and turn fragrant. 2 add the drained rice and sauté gently for 2 minutes to coat each grain. 3 add water and salt; select boil (speed 1–2, 100°c) and cook until the water is absorbed and the rice is fluffy. 4 rest covered for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork and garnish with coriander. tip: resist stirring too much once the rice starts cooking — it breaks the grains and makes the rice sticky.

recipes.title: Aloo Jeera (Dry Potato Sabzi)
recipes.search: aloo jeera (dry potato sabzi) aloo jeera (dry potato sabzi) chef magic – sauté auto 16 min — serves 4 gluten-free • vegan • everyday • low-oil ingredients 4 medium potatoes, boiled and cubed 1 tsp cumin seeds (jeera) 1/4 tsp turmeric (haldi) 1/2 tsp red chilli powder (lal mirch powder) 1/4 tsp amchur (dry mango powder) 1 tbsp oil salt to taste chopped coriander (dhania) to garnish method 1 add oil and cumin seeds to the jar; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) until the seeds splutter. 2 add the boiled potato cubes, turmeric, chilli powder and salt. 3 continue on sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) for 12 minutes, stirring gently, until the potatoes are lightly golden at the edges. 4 sprinkle with amchur and toss well; garnish with coriander before serving. tip: boil the potatoes just until fork-tender and cool them fully before cubing — this keeps the pieces from breaking apart in the

recipes.title: Moong Dal Tadka (Everyday Yellow Dal)
recipes.search: moong dal tadka (everyday yellow dal) moong dal tadka (everyday yellow dal) chef magic – sauté + boil auto 20 min — serves 4 gluten-free • vegetarian • high-protein • everyday • low-oil prep ahead: wash and soak the moong dal for 15 minutes to shorten the cooking time. ingredients 1 cup yellow moong dal, washed 3 cups water 1/4 tsp turmeric (haldi) 1 tsp cumin seeds (jeera) 1 dried red chilli (lal mirch) 2 cloves garlic (lehsun), thinly sliced 1 tbsp ghee salt to taste chopped coriander (dhania) to garnish method 1 add dal, water, turmeric and salt to the jar; select boil (speed 1–2, 100°c) and cook until soft and slightly mushy. 2 add ghee, cumin seeds, dried red chilli and garlic directly to the cooked dal; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) for 2 minutes to temper until the garlic turns golden. 3 stir well and garnish with coriander before serving with rice or roti. tip: this is the everyday, no-fuss dal most indian homes make on a busy weeknight — quick, light, and easy on the stomach.

recipes.title: Patta Gobi Sabzi (Simple Cabbage Stir-Fry)
recipes.search: patta gobi sabzi (simple cabbage stir-fry) patta gobi sabzi (simple cabbage stir-fry) chef magic – sauté auto 14 min — serves 4 gluten-free • vegan • everyday • low-oil ingredients 3 cups shredded cabbage 1/4 cup grated carrot 1 tsp mustard seeds (rai) 1/2 tsp cumin seeds (jeera) 1/4 tsp turmeric (haldi) 1 green chilli (hari mirch), chopped 1 tbsp oil salt to taste 1 tbsp grated fresh coconut (optional) method 1 add oil, mustard seeds and cumin seeds to the jar; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) until the seeds splutter. 2 add the green chilli and turmeric; sauté 30 seconds. 3 add the shredded cabbage, carrot and salt; continue on sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until just tender but still with a little crunch. 4 toss with fresh coconut if using, and serve warm. tip: don’t overcook the cabbage — a few minutes past tender-crisp and it turns watery and loses its everyday appeal.

recipes.title: Plain Steamed Basmati Rice
recipes.search: plain steamed basmati rice plain steamed basmati rice chef magic – boil auto 14 min — serves 4 gluten-free • vegan • no-cook finish • everyday prep ahead: rinse the rice 2–3 times until the water runs clear, to wash off surface starch. ingredients 1.5 cups basmati or regular rice, rinsed 2.5 cups water 1/2 tsp salt (optional) 1/2 tsp oil or ghee (optional) method 1 add the rinsed rice, water, salt and oil (if using) to the jar. 2 select boil (speed 1–2, 100°c) and cook until the water is fully absorbed and the rice is tender. 3 rest covered for 5 minutes, then fluff gently with a fork before serving. tip: the everyday side for almost any dal or curry in this book — keep it simple and don’t skip the resting step.

recipes.title: Homemade Curd (Dahi)
recipes.search: homemade curd (dahi) homemade curd (dahi) no-cook (chef magic warm optional) — 10 min + set overnight makes ~4 cups gluten-free • vegetarian • gut-friendly • probiotic • no-cook • everyday prep ahead: the milk should be lukewarm (not hot) when the starter culture is added, or the culture will die. ingredients 4 cups full-fat milk, boiled and cooled to lukewarm 2 tbsp fresh curd (as starter culture) method 1 whisk the starter curd until smooth, then stir it into the lukewarm milk. 2 pour into a clean container with a lid. 3 leave undisturbed in a warm spot for 6–8 hours, or overnight, until fully set. 4 chill for at least 1 hour before serving; use a spoonful as the starter for your next batch. tip: a warm oven with just the light on, or wrapping the container in a towel, helps curd set faster in cold weather.

recipes.title: Instant Lemon Pickle (Quick Nimbu Achaar)
recipes.search: instant lemon pickle (quick nimbu achaar) instant lemon pickle (quick nimbu achaar) chef magic – sauté auto 10 min + rest 1 day makes ~1 cup gluten-free • vegan • no-cook finish • everyday prep ahead: best made at least a day ahead so the lemons soften and the flavours meld. ingredients 4 lemons, cut into small pieces, seeds removed 2 tbsp salt 1 tsp turmeric (haldi) 1 tsp red chilli powder (lal mirch powder) 1/2 tsp fenugreek (methi) seeds, roasted and crushed 2 tbsp mustard oil (sarson ka tel) 1/2 tsp asafoetida (hing) method 1 toss the lemon pieces with salt and turmeric; set aside for 10 minutes to release their juices. 2 add mustard oil to the jar; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) and heat for 1 minute, then add asafoetida and crushed fenugreek; sauté 30 seconds until fragrant. 3 add the salted lemon pieces and chilli powder; sauté gently for 3 minutes to combine, then cool completely. 4 transfer to a clean, dry jar and rest at room temperature for at least a day before serving, stirring once daily. tip: a small everyday spoonful alongside dal-rice or paratha is the classic way to serve this — it keeps well in the fridge for

recipes.title: Kadhi (Yogurt & Gram Flour Curry)
recipes.search: kadhi (yogurt & gram flour curry) kadhi (yogurt & gram flour curry) chef magic – sauté + boil auto 24 min — serves 4 gluten-free • vegetarian • everyday prep ahead: whisk the yogurt and besan together well before it goes near heat, so the curry stays smooth instead of curdling. ingredients 1.5 cups sour yogurt, whisked 3 tbsp besan (gram flour (besan)) 2.5 cups water 1 tsp mustard seeds (rai) 1/2 tsp fenugreek (methi) seeds 9 curry leaves (kadi patta) 2 dried red chillies (lal mirch) 1/4 tsp turmeric (haldi) 1 tbsp oil or ghee salt to taste chopped coriander (dhania) to garnish method 1 whisk the yogurt, besan and water together until completely lump-free. 2 add oil, mustard seeds, fenugreek seeds, curry leaves and dried red chillies to the jar; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) until the seeds splutter. 3 add the yogurt-besan mixture and turmeric; select boil (speed 1–2, 100°c) and cook, stirring occasionally, for 18 minutes until thickened and no longer raw-tasting. 4 season with salt and garnish with coriander; serve hot with steamed rice. tip: keep the heat gentle and stir often once the yogurt goes in — a hard boil is what makes kadhi split.

recipes.title: Palak Dal (Spinach Dal)
recipes.search: palak dal (spinach dal) palak dal (spinach dal) chef magic – sauté + boil auto 22 min — serves 4 gluten-free • vegan • high-fibre • everyday ingredients 1 cup toor or moong dal, washed 2 cups spinach, chopped 3 cups water 1/4 tsp turmeric (haldi) 1 tsp cumin seeds (jeera) 2 cloves garlic (lehsun), chopped 1 dried red chilli (lal mirch) 1 tbsp ghee or oil salt to taste method 1 add dal, water, turmeric and salt to the jar; select boil (speed 1–2, 100°c) and cook until nearly soft. 2 add the chopped spinach and continue on boil (speed 1–2, 100°c) for 5 minutes until the dal is fully soft and the spinach has wilted in. 3 add ghee, cumin seeds, garlic and dried red chilli directly to the cooked dal; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) for 2 minutes to temper until the garlic turns golden. 4 stir well and serve hot with rice or roti. tip: an easy way to sneak greens into a daily dal without changing the flavour much — the spinach mostly disappears into the

recipes.title: Gajar Matar Sabzi (Carrot & Peas Stir-Fry)
