recipes.search: schezwan fried rice schezwan fried rice chef magic – sauté auto 18 min — serves 3 vegan • everyday • indo-chinese prep ahead: use day-old, chilled rice — freshly cooked warm rice turns mushy when fried. ingredients 3 cups cooked rice, chilled 1/2 cup finely chopped mixed vegetables (carrot, beans, capsicum) 2 tbsp schezwan sauce (store-bought or homemade) 1 tbsp soy sauce 1 tsp vinegar 2 spring onions, sliced 2 tbsp oil salt to taste method 1 add oil to the jar; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) and cook the mixed vegetables for 4 minutes until just tender. 2 add the schezwan sauce, soy sauce and vinegar; sauté 1 minute until fragrant. 3 add the chilled rice and salt; sauté for 9 minutes, tossing and breaking up clumps, until well coated and heated through. 4 fold in the spring onions for the last 2 minutes and serve hot. tip: go easy on the schezwan sauce at first and taste as you go — brands vary a lot in heat level.

recipes.title: American Chopsuey
recipes.search: american chopsuey american chopsuey airfryer (crisp the noodles) → chef magic 190°c crisp 10 min + gravy 16 min (make the gravy) — serves 4 vegetarian • everyday • indo-chinese ingredients 150g thin noodles, boiled and cooled 2 tbsp cornflour, plus extra for tossing oil spray 1/2 cup finely chopped mixed vegetables (carrot, beans, capsicum, cabbage) 2 tbsp tomato ketchup 1 tbsp chilli sauce 1 tbsp soy sauce 2 cups vegetable stock or water 2 tsp cornflour, mixed with water, for the slurry 2 tbsp oil salt & pepper to taste method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 190°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 toss the boiled noodles lightly in cornflour and spray with oil; spread in the basket. 3 air-fry at 190°c for 10 minutes, shaking halfway, until golden and crisp; set aside. 4 in chef magic, add oil; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) and cook the mixed vegetables for 5 minutes. 5 add ketchup, chilli sauce, soy sauce and stock; select boil (speed 1–2, 100°c) and simmer for 6 minutes. 6 stir in the cornflour slurry and cook a further 3 minutes until the gravy turns glossy and slightly thick. season with salt and pepper. 7 ladle the hot sweet-and-tangy gravy over the crispy noodles just before serving so they stay crunchy underneath. tip: keep the noodles and gravy separate until the table — plated too early, the noodles turn soft under the sauce.

recipes.title: Honey Chilli Potato
recipes.search: honey chilli potato honey chilli potato airfryer (fry the potatoes) → chef magic (toss 200°c fry 18 min + toss 6 min in glaze) — serves 4 vegetarian • everyday • indo-chinese prep ahead: par-boil the potato strips for 3 minutes before coating, so the inside stays soft while the outside crisps up. ingredients 4 medium potatoes, cut into thick matchsticks, par-boiled 3 min 3 tbsp cornflour 2 tbsp maida (plain flour) salt to taste oil spray 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste (adrak-lehsun paste) 1 capsicum, sliced 2 tbsp soy sauce 1 tbsp chilli sauce 2 tbsp honey 1 tsp toasted sesame seeds spring onion greens to garnish method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 200°c for 4 minutes before adding the food. 2 pat the par-boiled potato strips dry and toss with cornflour, maida and salt until evenly coated. 3 spray generously with oil and arrange in a single layer in the airfryer basket. 4 air-fry at 200°c for 18 minutes, shaking every 5 minutes, until deep golden and crisp. 5 in chef magic, add a little oil; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) and cook ginger-garlic paste and capsicum for 2 minutes. 6 add soy sauce, chilli sauce and honey; simmer on sauté (speed 1–2, ~100–110°c) for 2 minutes until it turns into a light, sticky glaze. 7 toss in the crispy potatoes just before serving; sprinkle with sesame seeds and spring onion. tip: toss the potatoes in the honey glaze at the very last second — honey-based sauces soften a crisp coating faster than a

recipes.title: Dragon Paneer (Dry)
recipes.search: dragon paneer (dry) dragon paneer (dry) airfryer (fry the paneer) → chef magic (toss in 200°c fry 14 min + toss 8 min sauce) — serves 4 vegetarian • everyday • indo-chinese ingredients 250g paneer, cut into batons 3 tbsp cornflour 2 tbsp maida (plain flour) 1 tbsp soy sauce, divided oil spray 1 capsicum, julienned 1 onion, julienned 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste (adrak-lehsun paste) 2 tbsp chilli-garlic (lehsun) sauce 1 tbsp tomato ketchup 1 tsp vinegar 1/2 tsp red chilli (lal mirch) flakes roasted cashews, roughly crushed, to garnish method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 200°c for 4 minutes before adding the food. 2 toss the paneer batons with cornflour, maida and half the soy sauce until coated. 3 spray with oil and arrange in a single layer in the airfryer basket. 4 air-fry at 200°c for 14 minutes, shaking halfway, until golden and crisp. 5 in chef magic, add a little oil; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) and cook capsicum, onion and ginger-garlic paste for 4 minutes, keeping the vegetables crisp. 6 add remaining soy sauce, chilli-garlic sauce, ketchup, vinegar and chilli flakes; cook 2 minutes until glossy. 7 toss in the fried paneer just before serving; scatter with crushed cashews. tip: dragon-style dishes lean spicier and drier than manchurian, with no cornflour slurry thickening the sauce — keep the glaze

recipes.title: Honey Chilli Cauliflower
recipes.search: honey chilli cauliflower honey chilli cauliflower airfryer (fry the florets) → chef magic (toss in 200°c fry 15 min + toss 6 min glaze) — serves 4 vegetarian • everyday • indo-chinese ingredients 1 medium cauliflower, cut into florets 3 tbsp cornflour 2 tbsp maida (plain flour) salt to taste oil spray 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste (adrak-lehsun paste) 1 tbsp soy sauce 1 tbsp chilli sauce 2 tbsp honey 1 tsp toasted sesame seeds spring onion greens to garnish method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 200°c for 4 minutes before adding the food. 2 toss the cauliflower florets with cornflour, maida, salt and a splash of water to form a light coating. 3 spray generously with oil and arrange in a single layer in the airfryer basket. 4 air-fry at 200°c for 15 minutes, shaking halfway, until golden and crisp. 5 in chef magic, add a little oil; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) and cook the ginger-garlic paste for 1 minute. 6 add soy sauce, chilli sauce and honey; simmer on sauté (speed 1–2, ~100–110°c) for 2 minutes until it turns into a light, sticky glaze. 7 toss in the crispy florets just before serving; sprinkle with sesame seeds and spring onion. tip: this is the sweeter, honey-glazed cousin of gobi manchurian elsewhere in this chapter — less tangy, more caramelised.

recipes.title: Bruschetta with Airfryer-Toasted Bread
recipes.search: bruschetta with airfryer-toasted bread bruschetta with airfryer-toasted bread airfryer – bake 190°c 5 min — serves 4 vegetarian • everyday • italian ingredients 8 slices baguette or crusty bread 2 tbsp olive oil, divided 3 tomatoes, finely diced 2 cloves garlic, 1 minced + 1 whole for rubbing 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil salt & pepper to taste 1 tsp balsamic vinegar (optional) method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 190°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 brush bread slices with olive oil and arrange in the basket. 3 bake at 190°c for 5 minutes until golden and crisp; rub each slice with the whole garlic clove while warm. 4 mix diced tomatoes, minced garlic, basil, remaining olive oil, salt, pepper and balsamic vinegar. 5 spoon the tomato mixture over the toasted bread just before serving.

recipes.title: Mushroom Risotto
recipes.search: mushroom risotto mushroom risotto chef magic – sauté + boil auto 26 min — serves 3 gluten-free • vegetarian • italian ingredients 1 cup arborio (risotto) rice 200g mushrooms, sliced 1 small onion, finely chopped 1 clove garlic, minced 3 cups hot vegetable stock 1/2 cup white wine or extra stock 1/4 cup grated parmesan 2 tbsp butter salt & pepper to taste method 1 add butter to the jar; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) and cook the onion and mushrooms for 6 minutes until softened. 2 add garlic and rice; sauté 2 minutes until the rice grains turn glossy. 3 add wine, then gradually add hot stock; select boil (speed 1–2, 100°c) and cook, stirring occasionally, for 16 minutes until rice is creamy and tender. 4 stir in remaining butter, parmesan, salt and pepper before serving.

recipes.title: Pasta Aglio e Olio
recipes.search: pasta aglio e olio pasta aglio e olio chef magic – boil then sauté auto 16 min — serves 2 vegan • everyday • italian ingredients 200g spaghetti 4 cloves garlic, thinly sliced 1/2 tsp red chilli flakes 4 tbsp olive oil salt to taste chopped parsley grated parmesan (optional) method 1 add water and a pinch of salt to the jar; select boil (speed 1–2, 100°c) and cook spaghetti until al dente, about 10 minutes; drain and reserve some pasta water. 2 add olive oil to the jar; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) and cook sliced garlic and chilli flakes for 2 minutes until fragrant, not browned. 3 add the drained pasta and reserved pasta water; toss on sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) for 2 minutes to coat. 4 finish with parsley, salt and parmesan if using.

recipes.title: Penne Arrabbiata (Spicy Tomato Pasta)
recipes.search: penne arrabbiata (spicy tomato pasta) penne arrabbiata (spicy tomato pasta) chef magic – boil then sauté auto 22 min — serves 3 vegan • everyday • italian ingredients 250g penne pasta 3 tbsp olive oil 4 cloves garlic, finely chopped 1 tsp red chilli flakes (adjust to taste) 400g canned tomatoes, crushed (or 5 fresh tomatoes, pureed) 1 tsp dried oregano 1/2 tsp sugar salt to taste chopped basil or parsley, to garnish grated parmesan (optional) method 1 add water and a pinch of salt to the jar; select boil (speed 1–2, 100°c) and cook penne until al dente, about 11 minutes; drain and reserve a little pasta water. 2 add olive oil to the jar; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) and cook garlic and chilli flakes for 1 minute until fragrant, not browned. 3 add the crushed tomatoes, oregano, sugar and salt; simmer on sauté (speed 1–2, ~100–110°c) for 8 minutes until the sauce thickens and deepens in colour. 4 add the drained penne and a splash of the reserved pasta water; toss on sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) for 2 minutes until well coated. 5 finish with basil or parsley and parmesan if using; serve hot. tip: "arrabbiata" means angry in italian — the chilli flakes are meant to bring real heat, so don't be shy with them.

recipes.title: Minestrone Soup
recipes.search: minestrone soup minestrone soup chef magic – sauté + boil auto 28 min — serves 4 vegan • high-fibre • italian • healthy ingredients 1 onion, chopped 2 carrots, diced 2 celery stalks, chopped 2 cloves garlic, minced 1 can (400g) chopped tomatoes 1 cup cooked kidney or cannellini beans 1/2 cup small pasta 4 cups vegetable stock 2 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp dried italian herbs salt & pepper to taste method 1 add olive oil to the jar; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) and cook onion, carrots and celery for 7 minutes until softened. 2 add garlic and italian herbs; cook 1 minute, then add chopped tomatoes and stock. 3 select boil (speed 1–2, 100°c) and cook for 12 minutes, then add beans and pasta. 4 continue on boil (speed 1–2, 100°c) for 8 minutes until pasta is tender; season with salt and pepper before serving.

recipes.title: Ratatouille
recipes.search: ratatouille ratatouille chef magic – sauté auto 26 min — serves 4 gluten-free • vegan • french • healthy ingredients 1 eggplant, diced 1 zucchini, diced 1 bell pepper, diced 2 tomatoes, chopped 1 onion, chopped 2 cloves garlic, minced 3 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp dried herbes de provence (or mixed herbs) salt & pepper to taste fresh basil to garnish method 1 add olive oil to the jar; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) and cook the onion for 5 minutes until soft. 2 add garlic and bell pepper; cook 4 minutes. 3 add eggplant and zucchini; sauté 8 minutes until beginning to soften. 4 add tomatoes, herbs, salt and pepper; simmer on sauté (speed 1–2, ~100–110°c) for 9 minutes until all vegetables are tender. garnish with basil.

recipes.title: Crustless Vegetable Quiche
recipes.search: crustless vegetable quiche crustless vegetable quiche airfryer – bake 170°c 22 min — serves 4 gluten-free • vegetarian • high-protein • french ingredients 5 eggs 1/2 cup milk or cream 1/2 cup chopped spinach 1/4 cup chopped bell pepper 1/4 cup grated cheese salt & pepper to taste 1/4 tsp nutmeg (optional) method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 170°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 whisk eggs with milk, salt, pepper and nutmeg. 3 stir in spinach, bell pepper and cheese. 4 pour the mixture into a greased oven-safe dish that fits the basket. 5 bake at 170°c for 22 minutes until set in the centre and lightly golden on top.

recipes.title: Greek Salad
recipes.search: greek salad greek salad no-cook — 10 min — serves 4 gluten-free • vegetarian • no-cook • mediterranean • healthy ingredients 2 tomatoes, chopped into wedges 1 cucumber, sliced 1/2 red onion, thinly sliced 1/2 cup kalamata olives 150g feta, cubed 3 tbsp olive oil 1 tbsp red wine vinegar 1 tsp dried oregano salt & pepper to taste method 1 combine tomatoes, cucumber, red onion and olives in a bowl. 2 whisk olive oil, red wine vinegar, oregano, salt and pepper; pour over the vegetables and toss. 3 top with cubed feta and a final drizzle of olive oil before serving.

recipes.title: Hummus
recipes.search: hummus hummus chef magic – boil then whisk auto 22 min — serves 4 gluten-free • vegan • high-protein • mediterranean prep ahead: soak dried chickpeas overnight, or use 1 can (400g) drained chickpeas to skip the boiling step. ingredients 1 cup chickpeas, soaked overnight (or 1 can, drained) 3 tbsp tahini 2 tbsp lemon juice 2 cloves garlic 3 tbsp olive oil, plus extra to serve 1/2 tsp cumin salt to taste water as needed method 1 if using dried chickpeas, add to the jar with water to cover; select boil (speed 1–2, 100°c) and cook for 18 minutes until very soft. drain, reserving some liquid. 2 add the chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, olive oil, cumin and salt to the jar. 3 select whisk/blend (speed 8–10), adding a little reserved liquid or water as needed, until smooth and creamy. 4 spoon into a bowl, drizzle with olive oil, and serve with pita or vegetables.

recipes.title: Crispy Falafel
recipes.search: crispy falafel crispy falafel airfryer – fry 200°c 16 min makes ~14 vegan • high-protein • mediterranean prep ahead: use dried chickpeas soaked overnight (not canned) — canned chickpeas make the mixture too wet to hold ingredients 1.5 cups dried chickpeas, soaked overnight 1 small onion, roughly chopped 3 cloves garlic 1 cup chopped parsley & coriander 1 tsp cumin 1 tsp coriander powder 1/2 tsp baking soda 2 tbsp flour salt to taste oil spray method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 200°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 in a food processor or chef magic’s chop function, blend the soaked (uncooked) chickpeas, onion, garlic and herbs to a coarse, sticky paste. 3 mix in cumin, coriander powder, baking soda, flour and salt; shape into small patties. 4 spray the patties with oil and arrange in the basket. 5 air-fry at 200°c for 16 minutes, flipping halfway, until deep golden and crisp.

recipes.title: Tzatziki
recipes.search: tzatziki tzatziki no-cook — 8 min — serves 4 gluten-free • vegetarian • no-cook • mediterranean • gut-friendly • probiotic prep ahead: squeeze the grated cucumber well to remove excess water, or the dip will turn watery. ingredients 1 cup thick yogurt 1/2 cucumber, grated and squeezed dry 1 clove garlic, minced 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp lemon juice 1 tsp chopped dill or mint salt to taste method 1 mix yogurt, squeezed grated cucumber, garlic, olive oil, lemon juice, dill and salt. 2 chill for at least 30 minutes before serving for the flavours to meld.

recipes.title: Patatas Bravas
recipes.search: patatas bravas patatas bravas airfryer (fry potatoes) → chef magic (make 200°c fry 18 min + sauce 10 min sauce) — serves 4 gluten-free • vegan • spanish ingredients 4 potatoes, cubed 2 tbsp oil salt to taste 1 can (400g) chopped tomatoes 1 tsp smoked paprika 1/2 tsp cayenne pepper 1 clove garlic, minced 1 tbsp olive oil method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 200°c for 4 minutes before adding the food. 2 toss the potato cubes with oil and salt and arrange in the basket. 3 air-fry at 200°c for 18 minutes, shaking halfway, until golden and crisp. 4 meanwhile, add olive oil to chef magic’s jar; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) and cook garlic for 1 minute. 5 add chopped tomatoes, smoked paprika and cayenne; simmer on sauté (speed 1–2, ~100–110°c) for 9 minutes until thickened. spoon over the crispy potatoes.

recipes.title: Spanish Tortilla (Potato Omelette)
recipes.search: spanish tortilla (potato omelette) spanish tortilla (potato omelette) chef magic (cook potatoes) → airfryer (set the 170°c sauté 15 min + bake 15 min omelette) — serves 4 gluten-free • vegetarian • spanish ingredients 3 potatoes, thinly sliced 1 onion, thinly sliced 3 tbsp olive oil 6 eggs salt & pepper to taste method 1 preheat: when you reach the airfryer step, preheat it to 170°c for 4 minutes before adding the food. 2 add olive oil to the jar; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) and cook the sliced potatoes and onion for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until soft (not browned). 3 whisk eggs with salt and pepper; fold in the cooked potatoes and onion. 4 pour the mixture into a greased oven-safe dish that fits the basket. 5 bake at 170°c for 15 minutes until just set in the centre. rest 5 minutes before slicing.

recipes.title: Baked Mac and Cheese
recipes.search: baked mac and cheese baked mac and cheese chef magic (cook pasta & sauce) → airfryer 180°c boil 10 min + bake 15 min (bake topping) — serves 4 vegetarian • american • everyday ingredients 2 cups macaroni 2 tbsp butter 2 tbsp flour 2 cups milk 1.5 cups grated cheddar 1/2 cup breadcrumbs salt & pepper to taste method 1 preheat: when you reach the airfryer step, preheat it to 180°c for 4 minutes before adding the food. 2 add water and salt to the jar; select boil (speed 1–2, 100°c) and cook macaroni until just tender, about 8 minutes; drain and set aside. 3 add butter to the jar; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c), whisk in flour, then gradually add milk, stirring until thickened, about 5 minutes. 4 stir in cheddar, salt and pepper, then fold in the cooked macaroni. 5 transfer to an oven-safe dish, top with remaining cheddar and breadcrumbs, and bake in the airfryer at 180°c for 15 minutes until golden and bubbling.

recipes.title: Soft Pretzels
recipes.search: soft pretzels soft pretzels chef magic (knead) → airfryer (bake) 190°c — knead 5 min + rest 1 hr + bake 12 min — makes 6 vegetarian • german ingredients 2.5 cups flour 1 tsp instant yeast 1 tsp sugar 1 cup warm water (105–110°f / 40–43°c) 1 tsp salt 1 tbsp butter, melted 1/4 cup baking soda + 2 cups water (for the bath) coarse salt to sprinkle 1 egg, beaten (for brushing) method 1 preheat: when you reach the airfryer step, preheat it to 190°c for 4 minutes before adding the food. 2 in chef magic, dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water heated to 105–110°f (40–43°c) — warm to the touch, not hot; anything above 120°f (49°c) will kill the yeast; rest 5–10 minutes until frothy. 3 add flour, salt and melted butter; select knead (speed 2–3, no heat) until a smooth, elastic dough forms. rest covered for 1 hour until doubled. 4 divide into 6 pieces, roll into ropes, and twist into pretzel shapes; dip each briefly in a bowl of baking soda dissolved in warm water. 5 brush pretzels with beaten egg, sprinkle with coarse salt, and arrange in the basket. 6 bake at 190°c for 12 minutes until deep golden-brown.

recipes.title: Paneer Souvlaki Skewers (Greek-Style)
recipes.search: paneer souvlaki skewers (greek-style) paneer souvlaki skewers (greek-style) airfryer – grill 200°c 14 min — serves 4 gluten-free • vegetarian • high-protein • mediterranean • everyday prep ahead: marinate the paneer for at least 20 minutes for the best flavour. ingredients 400g paneer, cubed 3 tbsp olive oil 2 tbsp lemon juice 2 cloves garlic, minced 1 tbsp dried oregano salt & pepper to taste bell pepper & red onion, cubed (optional, for skewering) method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 200°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 mix olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt and pepper; marinate the paneer (and vegetables, if using) for at least 3 minutes. 4 skewer or arrange in the basket. 5 grill at 200°c for 14 minutes, turning once, until lightly charred at the edges. 6 serve with pita, tzatziki and salad.

recipes.title: Veg Burger (Crispy Vegetable Patty Burger)
recipes.search: veg burger (crispy vegetable patty burger) veg burger (crispy vegetable patty burger) airfryer – bake 200°c 16 min — serves 4 vegetarian • everyday • continental prep ahead: chill the shaped patties in the fridge for at least 20 minutes before air-frying — this is what keeps them from falling apart. ingredients 3 medium potatoes, boiled & mashed 1/2 cup boiled mixed vegetables (carrot, peas, corn), lightly mashed 2 tbsp breadcrumbs, plus extra for coating 1 tbsp cornflour 1/2 tsp red chilli powder 1/2 tsp roasted cumin powder 1 tbsp chopped coriander salt to taste oil spray 4 burger buns butter, for toasting the buns lettuce leaves, tomato & onion slices mayonnaise, ketchup & mustard, to serve 4 cheese slices (optional) method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 200°c for 4 minutes before adding the food. 2 mix mashed potato, mashed mixed vegetables, breadcrumbs, cornflour, chilli powder, cumin powder, coriander and salt into a firm dough. 3 shape into 4 patties and chill for at least 20 minutes. 4 coat each patty lightly in extra breadcrumbs and spray generously with oil. 5 air-fry at 200°c for 16 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and crisp. 6 in the last 2 minutes, halve the buns and toast lightly (in the airfryer or on a hot pan) with a little butter; melt a cheese slice onto each patty if using. 7 assemble: bun base, sauces, lettuce, tomato, onion, the patty, and the bun top. serve hot. tip: if the mixture feels too soft to shape, add a little extra breadcrumbs rather than more cornflour — it keeps the patty light instead of dense.

recipes.title: Japchae (Glass Noodle Stir-Fry)
recipes.search: japchae (glass noodle stir-fry) japchae (glass noodle stir-fry) chef magic – sauté 12 min — serves 4 vegetarian • korean • everyday ingredients 200g sweet potato glass noodles (dangmyeon) 1 carrot, julienned 1 capsicum, thinly sliced 1 onion, thinly sliced 2 cups spinach 3 cloves garlic, minced 3 tbsp soy sauce 2 tbsp sugar 1 tbsp sesame oil 2 tbsp neutral oil toasted sesame seeds, to garnish method 1 soak the glass noodles in warm water for 20 minutes until pliable, then drain. 2 add the oil to the jar; select sauté (speed 2–3, ~140–150°c) and cook the garlic and onion for 2 minutes until fragrant. 3 add the carrot and capsicum; stir-fry for 3–4 minutes until just tender. 4 add the spinach and cook for 1 minute until wilted. 5 add the soaked noodles, soy sauce and sugar; toss everything together for 4–5 minutes until the noodles are glossy and evenly coated. 6 turn off the heat and stir in the sesame oil. garnish with sesame seeds and serve warm or at room temperature. tip: cut the noodles a few times with kitchen scissors after cooking — full-length dangmyeon can be tricky to serve and eat neatly.

recipes.title: Korean Fried Tofu (Dubu Jorim)
recipes.search: korean fried tofu (dubu jorim) korean fried tofu (dubu jorim) chef magic – sauté 15 min — serves 3 vegetarian • korean • high-protein • everyday ingredients 400g firm tofu, cut into 1cm slabs 2 tbsp cornflour 2 tbsp neutral oil 3 tbsp soy sauce 1 tbsp gochugaru 1 tbsp sugar 2 cloves garlic, minced 1 spring onion, sliced 1 tsp sesame oil toasted sesame seeds, to garnish method 1 pat the tofu slabs dry and dust lightly with cornflour on both sides. 2 add the oil to the jar; select sauté (speed 2–3, ~150–160°c) and pan-fry the tofu for 3–4 minutes per side until golden and crisp. set aside. 3 in the same jar, combine the soy sauce, gochugaru, sugar, garlic and 3 tbsp water; select sauté (speed 1–2, ~100–110°c) and simmer for 2 minutes until slightly thickened. 4 return the tofu to the jar, spooning the sauce over each piece, and simmer for 2–3 minutes until well coated. 5 stir in the sesame oil, sprinkle with spring onion and sesame seeds, and serve warm. tip: pressing the tofu for 15 minutes before cooking (under a weight, wrapped in a towel) helps it crisp up beautifully instead of steaming in the pan.

recipes.title: Kimchi Pancake (Kimchi Jeon)
recipes.search: kimchi pancake (kimchi jeon) kimchi pancake (kimchi jeon) chef magic – pan-fry 16 min — serves 3 vegetarian • korean • everyday ingredients 1 cup all-purpose flour 2 tbsp rice flour (for extra crispness) 1 cup kimchi, chopped 3 tbsp kimchi juice 3/4 cup water 2 spring onions, sliced 1 tsp sugar neutral oil, for pan-frying soy-vinegar dipping sauce (soy sauce, rice vinegar and a little sesame oil), to serve method 1 whisk together the flour, rice flour, kimchi juice, water and sugar into a smooth batter. 2 fold in the chopped kimchi and spring onions. 3 heat a generous layer of oil in a pan; select sauté (speed 2–3, ~150–160°c). 4 pour in a ladleful of batter, spreading it thin, and cook for 3–4 minutes until the underside is golden and crisp. 5 flip carefully and cook the other side for 3–4 minutes, pressing down gently for even crisping. 6 cut into wedges and serve hot with the dipping sauce. tip: a thinner pancake crisps up far better than a thick one — resist the urge to pile the batter high in the pan.

recipes.title: Korean Corn Cheese
recipes.search: korean corn cheese korean corn cheese airfryer – bake 180°c 10 min — serves 4 vegetarian • korean • everyday ingredients 2 cups sweet corn kernels (fresh, frozen or tinned, drained) 3 tbsp mayonnaise 1 tbsp sugar 1 cup grated mozzarella 1/4 cup chopped spring onion black pepper, to taste method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 180°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 mix the corn, mayonnaise, sugar and half the spring onion in an airfryer-safe dish. 3 top with the grated mozzarella and a good crack of black pepper. 4 air-fry at 180°c for 8–10 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbling with golden spots. 5 scatter over the remaining spring onion and serve hot, straight from the dish. tip: this is best served bubbling hot with a spoon — the cheese firms up quickly as it cools, so don't let it sit around too long.

recipes.title: Air-Fried Korean Cauliflower
recipes.search: air-fried korean cauliflower air-fried korean cauliflower airfryer + chef magic – fry 18 min + sauce 2 min — serves 4 vegetarian • korean • everyday ingredients 1 medium cauliflower, cut into florets 1/2 cup cornflour 1/2 cup water 1/2 tsp garlic powder salt to taste 3 tbsp gochujang 2 tbsp honey or sugar syrup 1 tbsp soy sauce 1 tbsp rice vinegar 1 clove garlic, minced toasted sesame seeds, to garnish method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 200°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 whisk the cornflour, water, garlic powder and salt into a smooth, thick batter. 3 dip each cauliflower floret in the batter, letting excess drip off, then arrange in the basket in a single layer. 4 air-fry at 200°c for 15–18 minutes, shaking halfway, until golden and crisp. 5 while the cauliflower cooks, combine the gochujang, honey, soy sauce, rice vinegar and garlic in the jar; select sauté (speed 1, ~90–100°c) and warm through for 2 minutes. 6 toss the hot cauliflower in the sauce and garnish with sesame seeds. serve immediately. tip: toss the cauliflower in the sauce just before serving, not earlier — sitting in the sauce too long will soften the crispy coating.

recipes.title: Kimchi Fried Rice
recipes.search: kimchi fried rice kimchi fried rice chef magic – sauté 10 min — serves 2 eggetarian • korean • everyday ingredients 2 cups cooked, day-old rice 1 cup kimchi, chopped 2 tbsp kimchi juice (from the jar) 2 tbsp gochujang 1 tbsp soy sauce 1 tsp sesame oil 2 spring onions, sliced 2 tbsp neutral oil 1 fried egg per serving (optional) toasted sesame seeds, to serve method 1 add the oil to the jar; select sauté (speed 2–3, ~140–150°c) and heat. 2 add the kimchi and cook for 2–3 minutes until slightly caramelised at the edges. 3 add the rice, breaking up any clumps, and stir-fry for 3–4 minutes until heated through. 4 stir in the kimchi juice, gochujang and soy sauce, tossing until evenly coated and the rice turns a light red-orange. 5 drizzle with sesame oil, scatter over the spring onions, and cook for 1 more minute. 6 serve hot, topped with a fried egg if using, and a sprinkle of sesame seeds. tip: day-old, cold rice fries up far better than fresh rice — the grains stay separate instead of turning mushy.

recipes.title: Tteokbokki (Spicy Rice Cakes)
recipes.search: tteokbokki (spicy rice cakes) tteokbokki (spicy rice cakes) chef magic – boil + sauté 20 min — serves 3 eggetarian • korean • everyday ingredients 400g korean rice cakes (tteok) 2 cups water or vegetable stock 3 tbsp gochujang 1 tbsp gochugaru (korean chilli flakes, optional) 1 tbsp soy sauce 1 tbsp sugar 1 onion, sliced 2 spring onions, cut into batons 1 boiled egg per serving (optional) method 1 if using refrigerated or frozen rice cakes, soak in warm water for 10 minutes to soften. 2 add the water/stock to the jar; select boil (speed 1, 100°c) and bring to a simmer. 3 whisk in the gochujang, gochugaru, soy sauce and sugar until dissolved. 4 add the onion and rice cakes; select sauté (speed 1–2, ~100–110°c) and simmer for 10–12 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens and coats the rice cakes. 5 add the spring onions in the last 2 minutes of cooking. 6 serve hot, topped with a halved boiled egg if using. tip: if the sauce gets too thick before the rice cakes are tender, splash in a little extra hot water to loosen it.

recipes.title: Bibimbap Bowl
recipes.search: bibimbap bowl bibimbap bowl stovetop prep – assemble 25 min — serves 2 eggetarian • korean • high-protein • everyday ingredients 2 cups cooked short-grain rice 1 carrot, julienned 1 cup spinach, blanched 1 cup bean sprouts, blanched 1 zucchini, julienned and sautéed 4 shiitake or button mushrooms, sliced and sautéed 2 eggs, fried sunny-side up 2 tbsp gochujang, per bowl 1 tsp sesame oil, per bowl toasted sesame seeds, to garnish salt to taste, for each vegetable method 1 prepare each vegetable separately: sauté the zucchini and mushrooms lightly with a pinch of salt; blanch the spinach and bean sprouts, then season each with a few drops of sesame oil and salt. 2 divide the warm rice between two bowls. 3 arrange the carrot, spinach, bean sprouts, zucchini and mushrooms in separate sections on top of the rice. 4 top each bowl with a fried egg. 5 add a generous spoonful of gochujang in the centre, drizzle with sesame oil, and scatter over sesame seeds. 6 mix everything together well just before eating. tip: the joy of bibimbap is in the mixing — stir everything together vigorously right before you eat so every bite gets a little of each ingredient.

recipes.title: Gochujang Sauce
recipes.search: gochujang sauce gochujang sauce chef magic – whisk/blend 3 min — makes ~3/4 cup vegetarian • korean • homemade ingredients 1/2 cup gochujang 2 tbsp soy sauce 2 tbsp sugar or honey 2 tbsp rice vinegar 1 tbsp sesame oil 2 cloves garlic, minced 1 tsp grated ginger 1 tbsp water (to loosen, if needed) method 1 add all the ingredients to the jar; select whisk/blend (speed 4–6) and blend until smooth. 2 taste and adjust sweetness or tang as needed, adding a splash of water if a thinner sauce is preferred. 3 transfer to a clean jar and refrigerate for up to 3 weeks. tip: this is the workhorse sauce for korean cooking in this book — use it as a glaze, a marinade base, or stirred into fried rice.

recipes.title: Ssamjang
recipes.search: ssamjang ssamjang no-cook – mix 5 min — makes ~1/2 cup vegetarian • korean • no-cook finish • homemade ingredients 3 tbsp doenjang (korean fermented soybean paste, or substitute white miso) 1 tbsp gochujang 1 tbsp sesame oil 1 tsp sugar 2 cloves garlic, minced 1 spring onion, finely chopped 1 tsp toasted sesame seeds method 1 in a bowl, combine the doenjang, gochujang, sesame oil and sugar, mixing until smooth. 2 stir in the garlic, spring onion and sesame seeds. 3 transfer to a small serving bowl. refrigerate any leftovers for up to 2 weeks. tip: ssamjang is traditionally served alongside grilled meats and lettuce wraps — a small dollop on each wrap adds a salty, savoury kick.

recipes.title: Korean BBQ Sauce (Bulgogi Marinade)
recipes.search: korean bbq sauce (bulgogi marinade) korean bbq sauce (bulgogi marinade) chef magic – whisk/blend 5 min — makes ~1 cup vegetarian • korean • homemade ingredients 1/2 cup soy sauce 3 tbsp brown sugar 2 tbsp sesame oil 1 asian pear or apple, grated (or 2 tbsp apple juice) 4 cloves garlic, minced 1 tbsp grated ginger 2 spring onions, chopped 1 tsp black pepper 1 tbsp toasted sesame seeds method 1 add all the ingredients except the sesame seeds to the jar; select whisk/blend (speed 6–8) and blend until smooth. 2 stir in the toasted sesame seeds. 3 use immediately as a marinade (marinate chicken or paneer for at least 1 hour), or bottle and refrigerate for up to 2 weeks. tip: the grated pear isn't just for sweetness — its natural enzymes help tenderise whatever you marinate in this sauce.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Perfect Boiled Eggs
recipes.search: air fryer perfect boiled eggs air fryer perfect boiled eggs airfryer – bake 130°c 15 min makes 6 gluten-free • eggetarian • high-protein • everyday ingredients 6 eggs, room temperature water for the ice bath method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 130°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 place eggs directly in the basket in a single layer, without overlapping. 3 air-fry at 130°c for 15 minutes for firm yolks (13 minutes for a slightly soft centre). 4 immediately transfer to an ice bath for 5 minutes to stop cooking. 5 peel once cool and use in salads, sandwiches, or as a snack with chaat masala. tip: cooking time varies by egg size and airfryer model — test one egg first time round and adjust by a minute either way.

recipes.title: Masala Egg Omelette
recipes.search: masala egg omelette masala egg omelette airfryer – bake 170°c 9 min — serves 2 gluten-free • eggetarian • high-protein • everyday ingredients 4 eggs 1/4 cup chopped onion, tomato, green chilli (hari mirch) 2 tbsp chopped coriander (dhania) 1/4 tsp turmeric (haldi) salt & pepper to taste 1 tsp oil or butter, for greasing method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 170°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 whisk eggs with turmeric, salt and pepper; stir in onion, tomato, chilli and coriander. 3 pour into a small greased oven-safe pan that fits the basket. 4 bake at 170°c for 9 minutes until just set and lightly golden at the edges. 5 slide out onto a plate and serve hot with toast.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Scotch Eggs
recipes.search: air fryer scotch eggs air fryer scotch eggs airfryer – fry 190°c 14 min — serves 4 high-protein • everyday prep ahead: chill the wrapped eggs for 15 minutes before air-frying so the coating holds together. ingredients 4 soft-boiled eggs, peeled 400g minced chicken or mutton 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste (adrak-lehsun paste) 1/2 tsp garam masala salt & pepper to taste 1/2 cup breadcrumbs 1 egg, beaten oil spray method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 190°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 mix mince with ginger-garlic paste, garam masala, salt and pepper. 3 divide into 4 portions and flatten each; wrap firmly around a peeled boiled egg, sealing all round. 4 dip each wrapped egg in beaten egg, then coat in breadcrumbs; chill 15 minutes. 5 spray with oil and arrange in the basket, spaced apart. 6 air-fry at 190°c for 14 minutes, turning halfway, until deep golden and cooked through. tip: wet your hands lightly while wrapping the mince — it stops the mixture sticking and cracking around the egg.

recipes.title: Deviled Eggs
recipes.search: deviled eggs deviled eggs no-cook — 10 min — makes 12 halves gluten-free • eggetarian • no-cook finish • everyday prep ahead: use the air fryer perfect boiled eggs recipe elsewhere in this book to hard-boil the eggs ahead of time. ingredients 6 hard-boiled eggs, halved 3 tbsp mayonnaise 1 tsp mustard 1/4 tsp roasted cumin powder (bhuna jeera powder) pinch of red chilli powder (lal mirch powder) or paprika salt to taste chopped coriander (dhania) or chives, to garnish method 1 scoop the yolks into a bowl, keeping the whites intact. 2 mash the yolks with mayonnaise, mustard, cumin powder and salt until smooth. 3 spoon or pipe the mixture back into the egg white halves. 4 dust with chilli powder or paprika and scatter with coriander. 5 chill for 15 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Bread Omelette Sandwich
recipes.search: bread omelette sandwich bread omelette sandwich chef magic (make omelette) → airfryer 180°c toast 4 min — serves 1 eggetarian • everyday ingredients 2 eggs 2 slices bread 1 small onion, finely chopped 1 small tomato, finely chopped 1 green chilli (hari mirch), finely chopped (optional) 1/4 tsp black pepper (kali mirch) 1 tbsp butter salt to taste tomato ketchup to serve method 1 preheat: when you reach the airfryer step, preheat it to 180°c for 3 minutes. 2 in chef magic, whisk the eggs with onion, tomato, green chilli, pepper and salt. 3 add butter to the jar; select sauté (speed 1–2, ~100–110°c) and pour in the egg mixture, cooking for 3 minutes until just set into a flat omelette. 4 sandwich the omelette between the two bread slices. 5 air-fry at 180°c for 4 minutes, flipping halfway, until the bread is golden and toasted. 6 slice diagonally and serve hot with ketchup. tip: cook the omelette to fit the bread slice — a flat, sandwich-shaped omelette holds together far better than a folded one.

recipes.title: Poached Eggs (Chef Magic Method)
recipes.search: poached eggs (chef magic method) poached eggs (chef magic method) chef magic – boil auto 4 min per batch — serves 2 gluten-free • eggetarian • high-protein • everyday ingredients 2–4 eggs, as fresh as possible 1 tsp vinegar water, as needed salt and pepper to taste toast, to serve method 1 fill the chef magic jar with water and add the vinegar; select boil (speed 1–2, 100°c) and bring to a gentle simmer, not a rolling boil. 2 crack each egg into a small cup first, then gently slide it into the simmering water. 3 let it cook undisturbed on boil (speed 1) for about 3 minutes, until the white is set but the yolk is still soft. 4 lift out with a slotted spoon and rest briefly on a paper towel to drain. 5 season with salt and pepper and serve on hot buttered toast. tip: the vinegar helps the whites set faster and stay together — don't skip it even if you can't taste it in the final egg.

recipes.title: Egg Salad (Sandwich Filling)
recipes.search: egg salad (sandwich filling) egg salad (sandwich filling) airfryer – boil eggs 130°c 15 min + mix — makes ~2 cups gluten-free • eggetarian • everyday ingredients 6 eggs, boiled, peeled and chopped 3 tbsp mayonnaise 1 tsp mustard (optional) 1/4 cup celery or onion, finely chopped 1/4 tsp black pepper (kali mirch) salt to taste bread or lettuce leaves to serve method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 130°c for 4 minutes before adding the eggs. 2 place the eggs in the basket in a single layer and air-fry at 130°c for 15 minutes; transfer immediately to an ice bath for 5 minutes. 3 peel and chop the eggs, keeping the pieces slightly chunky. 4 in a bowl, mix the chopped eggs with mayonnaise, mustard, celery or onion, pepper and salt. 5 use immediately as a sandwich filling, or spoon onto lettuce leaves for a lighter option. tip: chop the eggs by hand rather than mashing — a bit of texture makes a much better sandwich than a smooth paste.

recipes.title: Egg Bhurji (Spiced Scrambled Eggs)
recipes.search: egg bhurji (spiced scrambled eggs) egg bhurji (spiced scrambled eggs) chef magic – sauté auto 14 min — serves 3 gluten-free • eggetarian • high-protein • everyday ingredients 5 eggs 1 onion, finely chopped 1 tomato, finely chopped 1 green chilli (hari mirch), chopped 1/4 tsp turmeric (haldi) 1/2 tsp red chilli powder (lal mirch powder) 1 tbsp oil or butter salt to taste chopped coriander (dhania) to garnish method 1 add oil to the jar; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) and cook the onion and green chilli for 5 minutes until soft. 2 add tomato, turmeric and chilli powder; sauté 4 minutes until the tomato breaks down. 3 whisk the eggs with salt and pour into the jar; select sauté (speed 1–2, ~100–110°c) and cook, stirring gently, for 4 minutes until softly scrambled. 4 garnish with coriander and serve with toast or pav. tip: keep the heat gentle once the eggs go in — bhurji should stay soft and moist, not dry and rubbery.

recipes.title: Anda Curry (North Indian Egg Curry)
recipes.search: anda curry (north indian egg curry) anda curry (north indian egg curry) chef magic – sauté + boil auto 24 min — serves 4 gluten-free • high-protein • everyday prep ahead: lightly score the boiled eggs before adding them to the gravy so they soak up more flavour. ingredients 6 hard-boiled eggs, peeled 2 onions, chopped 2 tomatoes, pureed 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste (adrak-lehsun paste) 1 tsp red chilli powder (lal mirch powder) 1/2 tsp turmeric (haldi) 1 tsp coriander powder (dhania powder) 1/2 tsp garam masala 2 tbsp oil salt to taste chopped coriander (dhania) to garnish method 1 add oil to the jar; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) and cook onions for 6 minutes until golden. 2 add ginger-garlic paste, tomato puree, turmeric, chilli powder and coriander powder; sauté for 8 minutes until the oil separates. 3 add a splash of water and salt; select boil (speed 1–2, 100°c) and simmer for 5 minutes until the gravy thickens. 4 gently add the boiled eggs and garam masala; simmer on sauté (speed 1–2, ~100–110°c) for 5 minutes so the eggs soak up the gravy. garnish with coriander.

recipes.title: Egg Fried Rice
recipes.search: egg fried rice egg fried rice chef magic – sauté auto 16 min — serves 3 high-protein • everyday • indo-chinese prep ahead: use day-old, chilled rice — freshly cooked warm rice turns mushy when fried. ingredients 3 cups cooked rice, chilled 3 eggs, beaten 1/2 cup mixed vegetables (carrot, beans, spring onion), finely chopped 2 tbsp oil, divided 1 tbsp soy sauce 1/2 tsp white pepper (safed mirch) salt to taste method 1 add 1 tbsp oil to the jar; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) and scramble the beaten eggs for 2 minutes until just set; remove and set aside. 2 add the remaining oil to the jar; sauté the mixed vegetables for 4 minutes until just tender. 3 add the chilled rice, soy sauce, white pepper and salt; sauté for 8 minutes, breaking up clumps, until heated through. 4 fold the scrambled egg back in and toss for 2 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Dhaba-Style Egg Curry (Simple Everyday)
recipes.search: dhaba-style egg curry (simple everyday) dhaba-style egg curry (simple everyday) chef magic – sauté + boil auto 22 min — serves 3 gluten-free • eggetarian • everyday ingredients 5 eggs, boiled and peeled 2 onions, finely chopped 2 tomatoes, chopped 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste (adrak-lehsun paste) 1 tsp red chilli powder (lal mirch powder) 1/2 tsp turmeric (haldi) 1 tsp coriander powder (dhania powder) 1/2 tsp garam masala 3 tbsp oil 1 tsp cumin seeds (jeera) salt to taste coriander leaves (hara dhania) to garnish method 1 in chef magic, add oil; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) and crackle the cumin seeds for 30 seconds. 2 add onions and cook for 6 minutes until golden. 3 add ginger-garlic paste and cook for 1 minute, then add tomatoes, chilli powder, turmeric, coriander powder and salt; cook for 6 minutes until the oil separates. 4 add 1 cup water; select boil (speed 1–2, 100°c) and simmer for 5 minutes. 5 slit the boiled eggs lightly and slide them into the gravy; simmer for 5 minutes so they soak up the flavour. 6 sprinkle garam masala and coriander leaves before serving with rice or rotis. tip: this is the quick, everyday dhaba version — no cashew paste, no cream, just onion-tomato masala and boiled eggs.

recipes.title: Shakshuka (Baked Eggs in Tomato-Pepper Sauce)
recipes.search: shakshuka (baked eggs in tomato-pepper sauce) shakshuka (baked eggs in tomato-pepper sauce) chef magic (make sauce) → airfryer 180°c bake 10 min — serves 2 gluten-free • eggetarian • everyday ingredients 4 eggs 1 onion, chopped 1 red capsicum, chopped 3 tomatoes, chopped (or 1 cup crushed tomatoes) 2 cloves garlic (lehsun), minced 1/2 tsp cumin powder (jeera powder) 1/2 tsp paprika pinch of chilli flakes 2 tbsp olive oil salt and pepper to taste coriander (dhania) or parsley to garnish method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 180°c for 4 minutes before adding the food. 2 in chef magic, add olive oil; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) and cook the onion and capsicum for 6 minutes until softened. 3 add garlic, cumin, paprika and chilli flakes; sauté for 1 minute until fragrant. 4 add the tomatoes and salt; simmer on sauté (speed 1–2) for 8 minutes until thickened into a chunky sauce. 5 pour the sauce into an airfryer-safe dish, make small wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each well. 6 bake at 180°c for 10 minutes, until the whites are just set and the yolks are still soft. 7 garnish with coriander or parsley and serve straight from the dish with crusty bread. tip: pull it out while the yolks still jiggle slightly — they'll keep firming up from residual heat for a minute after baking.

recipes.title: Egg Bhurji Kathi Roll
recipes.search: egg bhurji kathi roll egg bhurji kathi roll chef magic (make bhurji) → airfryer 180°c warm rotis 3 min — makes 4 rolls eggetarian • everyday ingredients 4 eggs 1 onion, finely chopped 1 tomato, finely chopped 1 green chilli (hari mirch), chopped 1/2 tsp turmeric (haldi) 1/2 tsp red chilli powder (lal mirch powder) 4 rotis or flatbreads 2 tbsp oil sliced onions and mint chutney to serve salt to taste coriander leaves (hara dhania), chopped method 1 preheat: when you reach the airfryer step, preheat it to 180°c for 3 minutes. 2 in chef magic, add oil; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) and cook the onion for 4 minutes until soft. 3 add tomato, green chilli, turmeric, chilli powder and salt; cook for 3 minutes until the tomato softens. 4 crack in the eggs and scramble on sauté (speed 1–2) for 3 minutes until just set. stir in coriander leaves. 5 warm the rotis in the airfryer at 180°c for 3 minutes. 6 spread mint chutney on each roti, spoon the egg bhurji down the centre, top with sliced onions, and roll tightly. tip: roll while the bhurji is still warm and wrap the base in foil or parchment — it holds together much better for eating on the go.

recipes.title: Egg Drop Soup
recipes.search: egg drop soup egg drop soup chef magic – boil auto 12 min — serves 3 eggetarian • everyday ingredients 2 eggs, lightly beaten 4 cups vegetable or chicken stock 1 tbsp cornflour mixed with 2 tbsp water 1/2 tsp white pepper (safed mirch) 1 tsp soy sauce 1 tsp sesame oil spring onion greens, chopped, to garnish salt to taste method 1 in chef magic, add the stock; select boil (speed 1–2, 100°c) and bring to a simmer for 5 minutes. 2 stir in the cornflour slurry and cook for 2 minutes until the soup lightly thickens. 3 season with soy sauce, white pepper and salt. 4 with the jar on a gentle boil (speed 1), slowly drizzle in the beaten egg in a thin stream while stirring in one direction, so it sets into silky ribbons. 5 drizzle with sesame oil and garnish with spring onion greens before serving. tip: pour the egg in slowly and stir gently — pouring too fast or stirring hard turns the ribbons into scrambled bits.

recipes.title: Egg Hakka Noodles
recipes.search: egg hakka noodles egg hakka noodles chef magic – sauté auto 16 min — serves 3 eggetarian • everyday • indo-chinese ingredients 200g hakka noodles, boiled and drained 3 eggs, lightly beaten 1 carrot, julienned 1 capsicum, julienned 1/2 cup shredded cabbage 2 spring onions, chopped 2 cloves garlic (lehsun), minced 2 tbsp soy sauce 1 tsp vinegar 1/2 tsp black pepper (kali mirch) 2 tbsp oil salt to taste method 1 in chef magic, add 1 tbsp oil; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) and scramble the eggs for 2 minutes until just set. remove and set aside. 2 add the remaining oil and garlic; sauté for 1 minute until fragrant. 3 add the carrot, capsicum and cabbage; stir-fry for 3 minutes until just tender-crisp. 4 add the boiled noodles, soy sauce, vinegar, pepper and salt; toss on sauté for 4 minutes until well combined. 5 fold in the scrambled egg and spring onions; toss for 1 minute more and serve hot. tip: scrambling the egg separately and folding it in at the end keeps it in distinct soft curds instead of disappearing into the noodles.

recipes.title: Egg Kurma (South Indian Coconut Egg Curry)
recipes.search: egg kurma (south indian coconut egg curry) egg kurma (south indian coconut egg curry) chef magic – sauté + boil auto 26 min — serves 3 gluten-free • eggetarian • everyday ingredients 5 eggs, boiled and peeled 1 onion, chopped 1 tomato, chopped 1/2 cup grated coconut 1 tsp fennel seeds (saunf) 4 cashews 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste (adrak-lehsun paste) 1–2 green chillies (hari mirch) 1/2 tsp turmeric (haldi) 1 tsp coriander powder (dhania powder) 2 tbsp oil 1 sprig curry leaves (kadi patta) salt to taste method 1 in chef magic, blend the coconut, fennel seeds and cashews with a splash of water into a smooth paste; set aside. 2 add oil to the jar; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) and crackle the curry leaves for 30 seconds. 3 add the onion and cook for 5 minutes until soft, then add ginger-garlic paste and green chillies; cook for 1 minute. 4 add the tomato, turmeric, coriander powder and salt; cook for 5 minutes until soft. 5 stir in the coconut paste and 1 cup water; select boil (speed 1–2, 100°c) and simmer for 8 minutes until the gravy thickens slightly. 6 slit the boiled eggs lightly and slide them into the gravy; simmer for 5 minutes so they soak up the flavour before serving. tip: this is a milder, coconut-based cousin of north indian egg curry — lovely with appams, dosa or plain rice.

recipes.title: Whole Roast Chicken
recipes.search: whole roast chicken whole roast chicken airfryer – roast 180°c 48 min — serves 4 prep ahead: rub the chicken with oil and spices at least 1 hour ahead (or overnight in the fridge) for deeper flavour. ingredients 1 whole chicken (~1.2kg) 2 tbsp oil 1 tbsp mixed herbs 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic (lehsun) powder salt & pepper to taste method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 180°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 pat chicken dry; rub all over and under the skin with oil and spice mix. 3 place breast-side down in the basket; roast at 180°c for 25 minutes. 4 flip breast-side up and roast a further 22 minutes until juices run clear. 5 rest 10 minutes before carving. tip: check internal temperature reaches 74°c at the thickest part of the thigh.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Grilled Fish
recipes.search: garlic butter grilled fish garlic butter grilled fish airfryer – grill 190°c 11 min — serves 2 ingredients 2 fish fillets (pomfret/basa) 1 tbsp melted butter 1 tsp garlic (lehsun), minced 1/2 lemon, juiced salt & pepper to taste chopped parsley or coriander (dhania) method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 190°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 mix melted butter, garlic, lemon juice, salt and pepper; brush over fillets. 3 place fillets in the basket without overlapping. 4 grill at 190°c for 11 minutes, no need to flip thin fillets. 5 garnish with herbs and serve with extra lemon.

recipes.title: Mutton Seekh Kebab
recipes.search: mutton seekh kebab mutton seekh kebab airfryer – grill 190°c 15 min — serves 4 prep ahead: for best texture, mix and knead the kebab mixture, then rest it in the fridge for 25 minutes before shaping. ingredients 500g minced mutton 1 small onion, finely chopped 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste (adrak-lehsun paste) 1 green chilli (hari mirch), chopped 1 tsp garam masala 1 tbsp roasted gram flour (besan) 2 tbsp chopped coriander (dhania) salt to taste method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 190°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 mix all ingredients thoroughly and knead until the mince binds together. 3 shape into sausage-like kebabs around skewers or by hand. 4 place in the basket, spaced apart, and grill at 190°c for 15 minutes, turning halfway. 5 rest for a few minutes before serving with mint chutney.

recipes.title: Soy-Glazed Air Fryer Salmon
recipes.search: soy-glazed air fryer salmon soy-glazed air fryer salmon airfryer – grill 190°c 11 min — serves 2 prep ahead: marinate salmon for 15 minutes — no longer, as the soy sauce can start to firm up the fish. ingredients 2 salmon fillets 1 tbsp soy sauce 1 tsp honey 1/2 tsp grated ginger (adrak) 1/2 tsp sesame oil 1 clove garlic (lehsun), minced method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 190°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 mix soy sauce, honey, ginger, sesame oil and garlic; marinate salmon 15 minutes. 3 place fillets skin-side down in the basket. 4 grill at 190°c for 11 minutes, no need to flip. 5 serve with steamed rice and vegetables.

recipes.title: Lamb Chops with Herb Crust
recipes.search: lamb chops with herb crust lamb chops with herb crust airfryer – grill 190°c 15 min — serves 4 prep ahead: rub chops with the oil, garlic and herb mix and rest 20 minutes at room temperature before grilling. ingredients 6 lamb chops 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tbsp mixed dried herbs 2 cloves garlic (lehsun), minced salt & pepper to taste method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 190°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 rub chops with oil, garlic, herbs, salt and pepper; rest 20 minutes. 3 arrange in the basket without overlapping. 4 grill at 190°c for 15 minutes, turning once, for medium doneness. 5 rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Steak
recipes.search: air fryer steak air fryer steak airfryer – grill 200°c 10 min — serves 2 prep ahead: bring steak to room temperature for 25 minutes before cooking for even doneness. ingredients 2 steaks (ribeye/sirloin), ~2.5cm thick 1 tbsp oil 1 tsp salt 1/2 tsp black pepper (kali mirch) 1 clove garlic (lehsun), minced (optional) 1 tsp butter per steak (optional) method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 200°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 pat steaks dry, rub with oil, salt, pepper and garlic. 3 preheat the basket, then place steaks in a single layer. 4 grill at 200°c for 9 minutes for medium (adjust ±2 minutes for doneness), flipping halfway. 5 rest 5 minutes with a pat of butter on top before slicing.

recipes.title: Kosha Mangsho (Bengali Slow-Cooked Mutton Curry)
recipes.search: kosha mangsho (bengali slow-cooked mutton curry) kosha mangsho (bengali slow-cooked mutton curry) chef magic – sauté + boil auto 48 min — serves 4 gluten-free • bengali • high-protein prep ahead: marinate mutton with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste and spices for at least 1 hour (overnight is best) before cooking. ingredients 500g mutton, cut into pieces 1/2 cup yogurt 2 onions, finely sliced 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste (adrak-lehsun paste) 1 tsp red chilli powder (lal mirch powder) 1 tsp cumin (jeera)-coriander powder (dhania powder) 1/2 tsp garam masala 2 tbsp mustard oil (sarson ka tel) 2 bay leaves (tej patta) salt to taste method 1 marinate mutton with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste and spices for at least 1 hour. 2 add oil, bay leaves and onions to the jar; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) and cook until deep golden-brown. 3 add the marinated mutton; continue on sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c), stirring occasionally, for 18 minutes until well browned and the marinade has darkened. 4 add a little water, select boil (speed 1–2, 100°c), and cook covered until the mutton is tender and the gravy has thickened and turned deep brown. tip: kosha mangsho is meant to be a thick, ‘dry-ish’ curry — resist adding too much water.

recipes.title: Kashmiri Rogan Josh
recipes.search: kashmiri rogan josh kashmiri rogan josh chef magic – sauté + boil auto 48 min — serves 4 gluten-free • high-protein • kashmiri prep ahead: marinate the lamb with yogurt for at least 30 minutes before cooking for a more tender result. ingredients 500g lamb, cut into pieces 1/2 cup yogurt 2 tbsp kashmiri chilli powder (for colour, mild heat) 1 tsp fennel (saunf) powder 1/2 tsp ginger (adrak) powder (saunth) 2 bay leaves (tej patta) 3 cloves (laung), 2 green cardamom (elaichi) 3 tbsp mustard oil (sarson ka tel) salt to taste method 1 marinate the lamb with yogurt for at least 30 minutes. 2 add mustard oil, bay leaves and whole spices to the jar; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) until fragrant. 3 add the marinated lamb; sauté for 12 minutes, stirring occasionally, until browned. 4 add kashmiri chilli powder, fennel powder, ginger powder and salt with a little water; select boil (speed 1–2, 100°c) and cook covered until the lamb is tender and the gravy is thick and deep red.

recipes.title: Crispy Garlic Butter Air Fryer Prawns
recipes.search: crispy garlic butter air fryer prawns crispy garlic butter air fryer prawns airfryer – grill 200°c 8 min — serves 3 gluten-free • high-protein • everyday prep ahead: pat prawns completely dry before tossing — excess moisture stops them crisping. ingredients 500g prawns, peeled and deveined (tails on) 1 tbsp melted butter 1 tbsp oil 3 cloves garlic (lehsun), minced 1/2 tsp paprika salt & pepper to taste lemon wedges & chopped parsley, to serve method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 200°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 toss the prawns with melted butter, oil, garlic, paprika, salt and pepper. 3 arrange in a single layer in the basket, without overlapping. 4 air-fry at 200°c for 8 minutes, shaking halfway, until pink, opaque and lightly charred at the edges. 5 squeeze over lemon and scatter with parsley before serving. tip: prawns overcook fast — check at 6 minutes if yours are on the smaller side.

recipes.title: Tandoori Prawn Skewers
recipes.search: tandoori prawn skewers tandoori prawn skewers airfryer – grill 200°c 9 min — serves 3 gluten-free • high-protein prep ahead: marinate the prawns for 20–30 minutes only — much longer and the yogurt-lemon marinade starts to ‘cook’ the ingredients 500g prawns, peeled and deveined 1/2 cup thick yogurt 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste (adrak-lehsun paste) 1 tsp red chilli powder (lal mirch powder) 1/2 tsp garam masala 1 tbsp lemon juice 1 tbsp mustard oil (sarson ka tel) salt to taste method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 200°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 whisk together yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, chilli powder, garam masala, lemon juice, mustard oil and salt. 3 coat the prawns in the marinade and rest for 20–30 minutes. 4 skewer or arrange in a single layer in the basket. 5 grill at 200°c for 9 minutes, turning once, until charred at the edges and just cooked through. 6 serve with mint chutney and lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Prawn Malai Curry (Creamy Coconut Prawn Curry)
recipes.search: prawn malai curry (creamy coconut prawn curry) prawn malai curry (creamy coconut prawn curry) chef magic – sauté auto 22 min — serves 4 gluten-free • high-protein • bengali prep ahead: marinate the prawns with a little turmeric and salt for 10 minutes before cooking. ingredients 500g prawns, peeled and deveined 1 onion, finely sliced 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste (adrak-lehsun paste) 1 cup coconut milk 1/2 tsp turmeric (haldi) 1 tsp garam masala 2 green chillies (hari mirch), slit 2 tbsp mustard oil (sarson ka tel) salt to taste chopped coriander (dhania) to garnish method 1 add mustard oil to the jar; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) and cook the onion for 6 minutes until golden. 2 add ginger-garlic paste and turmeric; sauté 2 minutes. 3 add the coconut milk, green chillies and salt; simmer on sauté (speed 1–2, ~100–110°c) for 6 minutes until slightly thickened. 4 gently add the prawns and garam masala; sauté for 6 minutes until just cooked through — avoid overcooking or they turn rubbery. 5 garnish with coriander and serve with steamed rice. tip: prawn malai curry is meant to be lightly sweet and mild — don’t oversalt or over-spice the gravy.

recipes.title: Chilli Garlic Prawns
recipes.search: chilli garlic prawns chilli garlic prawns airfryer or chef magic — pick whichever you have free — 16 min — serves 4 high-protein • everyday prep ahead: marinate the prawns for 15 minutes with a little cornflour, salt and pepper for a lightly crisp coating. ingredients 500g prawns, peeled and deveined 1 tbsp cornflour 1 capsicum, sliced 1 onion, sliced 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste (adrak-lehsun paste) 2 tbsp chilli-garlic (lehsun) sauce 1 tbsp soy sauce 2 green chillies (hari mirch), sliced 2 tbsp oil salt & pepper to taste method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 200°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 option a – airfryer: toss prawns with cornflour, salt and pepper, spray with oil, and air-fry at 200°c for 8 minutes, shaking halfway, until just opaque. meanwhile sauté capsicum, onion, ginger-garlic paste and green chillies in oil in chef magic for 5 minutes, stir in chilli-garlic sauce and soy sauce, then toss in the air-fried prawns for 2 minutes before serving. 3 option b – chef magic only: sauté capsicum, onion, ginger-garlic paste and green chillies in oil for 5 minutes, add the prawns, chilli-garlic sauce and soy sauce, and sauté for 7 minutes, stirring gently, until the prawns are just cooked through.

recipes.title: Kerala-Style Prawn Curry
recipes.search: kerala-style prawn curry kerala-style prawn curry chef magic – sauté + boil auto 24 min — serves 4 gluten-free • high-protein • kerala prep ahead: soak 2–3 pieces of kokum in warm water for 10 minutes if using, to soften before adding. ingredients 500g prawns, peeled and deveined 1 onion, sliced 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste (adrak-lehsun paste) 1.5 tsp red chilli powder (lal mirch powder) 1/2 tsp turmeric (haldi) 1 cup coconut milk 2–3 pieces kokum (or 1 tbsp tamarind (imli) paste) 9 curry leaves (kadi patta) 2 tbsp coconut oil salt to taste method 1 add coconut oil and curry leaves to the jar; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) and cook the sliced onion for 6 minutes until soft. 2 add ginger-garlic paste, chilli powder and turmeric; sauté 2 minutes. 3 add coconut milk, kokum and salt; select boil (speed 1–2, 100°c) and simmer for 6 minutes. 4 gently add the prawns and simmer a further 5 minutes until just cooked through — avoid stirring hard. 5 serve hot with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Crispy Prawn Pakoras
recipes.search: crispy prawn pakoras crispy prawn pakoras airfryer or chef magic — pick whichever you have free — 18 min — serves 4 high-protein • everyday ingredients 500g prawns, peeled and deveined (tails on) 3/4 cup besan (gram flour (besan)) 1/2 tsp turmeric (haldi) 1/2 tsp red chilli powder (lal mirch powder) 1/4 tsp ajwain (carom seeds (ajwain)) 1 tbsp lemon juice salt to taste water as needed oil (for both methods) method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 190°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 whisk besan, turmeric, chilli powder, ajwain, lemon juice, salt and just enough water into a thick batter; coat the prawns. 3 option a – airfryer: spray generously with oil, arrange in a single layer in the basket, and air-fry at 190°c for 10 minutes, shaking halfway, until golden and crisp. 4 option b – chef magic: add 3 tbsp oil to the jar, select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c), and shallow-fry the prawns, turning gently, for 8 minutes until golden on both sides. combo recipes — chef magic + airfryer

recipes.title: Chicken Tikka (marinated & grilled)
recipes.search: chicken tikka (marinated & grilled) chicken tikka (marinated & grilled) chef magic (chop & mix marinade) → airfryer 190°c marinate 30 min + grill 13 min (grill) — serves 4 prep ahead: marinate the chicken for at least 30 minutes before grilling. ingredients 500g boneless chicken, cubed 1/2 cup thick yogurt 1 onion, roughly chopped 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste (adrak-lehsun paste) 1 tsp red chilli powder (lal mirch powder) 1/2 tsp garam masala 1 tbsp oil salt to taste method 1 preheat: when you reach the airfryer step, preheat it to 190°c for 4 minutes before adding the food. 2 in chef magic, chop the onion briefly, then add yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, spices, oil and salt; mix to combine into a marinade. 3 coat chicken pieces in the marinade and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. 4 skewer or arrange chicken in the airfryer basket. 5 grill at 190°c for 13 minutes, turning once, until charred at the edges and cooked through.

recipes.title: Momo to Fried Momo (Steam then Crisp)
recipes.search: momo to fried momo (steam then crisp) momo to fried momo (steam then crisp) chef magic (steam) → airfryer (fry, for a crisp finish) 190°c — steam 12 min + fry 7 min — makes ~15 ingredients 15 momo wrappers 1 cup finely chopped vegetables or minced chicken 1 tsp soy sauce 1/2 tsp ginger-garlic paste (adrak-lehsun paste) salt & pepper to taste oil spray method 1 preheat: when you reach the airfryer step, preheat it to 190°c for 4 minutes before adding the food. 2 mix filling ingredients and stuff into wrappers, pleating to seal. 3 steam in chef magic (100°c steam, paddle off) using the steamer tray for 11 minutes until wrappers turn glossy. 4 spray steamed momos lightly with oil and arrange in the airfryer basket. 5 air-fry at 190°c for 7 minutes until the outside turns crisp and lightly golden. tip: steaming first keeps the filling juicy while the air fryer finish adds the crunch steaming alone can’t.

recipes.title: Chicken 65
recipes.search: chicken 65 chicken 65 airfryer or chef magic — pick whichever you have free — marinate 30 min + cook 16 min — serves 4 prep ahead: marinate chicken for at least 30 minutes (longer in the fridge deepens the flavour). ingredients 500g boneless chicken, cubed 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste (adrak-lehsun paste) 1 tsp red chilli powder (lal mirch powder) 1/2 tsp turmeric (haldi) 2 tbsp curd 2 tbsp cornflour 1 tbsp rice flour salt to taste curry leaves (kadi patta) & 1 green chilli (hari mirch), slit, for tempering 1 tbsp oil method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 200°c for 4 minutes before adding the food. 2 marinate chicken with ginger-garlic paste, spices, curd, cornflour and rice flour for 30 minutes. 3 option a – airfryer: spray with oil, arrange in the basket in a single layer, air-fry at 200°c for 16 minutes, shaking halfway, until crisp and cooked through; toss with a quick curry leaf tempering before serving. 4 option b – chef magic: add oil to the jar, select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c), add curry leaves and green chilli briefly, then add marinated chicken and cook, stirring occasionally, for 14 minutes until crisp outside and cooked through.

recipes.title: Chicken Cutlets (Crispy Airfryer Croquettes)
recipes.search: chicken cutlets (crispy airfryer croquettes) chicken cutlets (crispy airfryer croquettes) chef magic (mince & mix) → airfryer 200°c 16 min — makes 10 high-protein • everyday prep ahead: chill the shaped cutlets for 15 minutes before air-frying so they hold together. ingredients 250g boneless chicken, minced or finely chopped 1 potato, boiled and mashed 1 onion, finely chopped 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste (adrak-lehsun paste) 1/2 tsp garam masala 1/2 tsp red chilli powder (lal mirch powder) 2 tbsp coriander leaves (hara dhania), chopped 1 egg, beaten 1 cup breadcrumbs salt to taste oil spray method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 200°c for 4 minutes before adding the food. 2 in chef magic, pulse the chicken briefly to mince if using whole pieces, then transfer to a bowl. 3 mix the minced chicken with mashed potato, onion, ginger-garlic paste, garam masala, chilli powder, coriander and salt. 4 shape the mixture into small flat patties; chill for 15 minutes. 5 dip each patty in beaten egg, then coat in breadcrumbs, pressing gently to stick. 6 spray generously with oil and arrange in a single layer in the airfryer basket. 7 air-fry at 200°c for 16 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and crisp on both sides. tip: chilling the shaped patties is the step people skip — don't; it's what stops them falling apart in the basket.

recipes.title: Peri Peri Chicken
recipes.search: peri peri chicken peri peri chicken airfryer – marinate 30 min + grill 200°c 18 min — serves 4 gluten-free • high-protein • everyday prep ahead: marinate the chicken for at least 30 minutes (overnight for deeper flavour). ingredients 500g chicken drumsticks or thighs 3 tbsp peri peri sauce (or blended red chillies (lal mirch), garlic (lehsun), paprika, lemon juice and oil) 1 tbsp lemon juice 1 tbsp oil 1/2 tsp smoked paprika salt to taste method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 200°c for 4 minutes before adding the food. 2 whisk together the peri peri sauce, lemon juice, oil, paprika and salt. 3 coat the chicken well in the marinade and rest for at least 30 minutes. 4 arrange the chicken in a single layer in the airfryer basket. 5 grill at 200°c for 18 minutes, turning once, until charred at the edges and cooked through. tip: baste with a spoon of the leftover marinade halfway through grilling for an extra glossy, spicy finish.

recipes.title: Reshmi Chicken Kebab (Malai Tikka)
recipes.search: reshmi chicken kebab (malai tikka) reshmi chicken kebab (malai tikka) chef magic (mix marinade) → airfryer 190°c marinate 30 min + grill 14 min — serves 4 gluten-free • high-protein • everyday prep ahead: marinate the chicken for at least 30 minutes (overnight is best for a silkier texture). ingredients 500g boneless chicken, cubed 1/4 cup hung curd (thick yogurt) 2 tbsp cream 1 tbsp cashew paste 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste (adrak-lehsun paste) 1/2 tsp white pepper (safed mirch) 1/2 tsp green chilli (hari mirch) paste 1 tbsp oil 1/2 tsp cardamom powder (elaichi powder) salt to taste method 1 preheat: when you reach the airfryer step, preheat it to 190°c for 4 minutes before adding the food. 2 in chef magic, blend the hung curd, cream, cashew paste, ginger-garlic paste, white pepper, green chilli paste, oil, cardamom powder and salt into a smooth marinade. 3 coat the chicken well in the marinade and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. 4 skewer or arrange the chicken in a single layer in the airfryer basket. 5 grill at 190°c for 14 minutes, turning once, until lightly golden with no charring (reshmi tikka should stay pale and creamy). tip: this is the 'no red colour' cousin of chicken tikka — keep the marinade white and let the cream and cashew do the work.

recipes.title: Chicken Momos
recipes.search: chicken momos chicken momos chef magic (steam) → airfryer (fry, for a crisp finish) 190°c — steam 14 min + fry 7 min — makes ~15 high-protein • everyday ingredients 250g minced chicken 1 small cabbage, finely shredded 1 carrot, grated 2 spring onions, chopped 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste (adrak-lehsun paste) 1 tsp soy sauce 1/2 tsp white pepper (safed mirch) 20 momo/dumpling wrappers salt to taste oil spray (for the fried version) method 1 in chef magic, mix the minced chicken, cabbage, carrot, spring onions, ginger-garlic paste, soy sauce, white pepper and salt into a filling. 2 place a spoonful of filling in the centre of each wrapper; pleat and seal into momo shapes. 3 arrange the momos in the chef magic steaming basket without touching; select steam and cook for 14 minutes until the wrapper turns glossy and the filling is cooked through. 4 for a crisp finish: spray the steamed momos with oil and air-fry at 190°c for 7 minutes, shaking halfway, until golden and lightly blistered. 5 serve hot with spicy chilli-garlic dip or momo chutney. tip: don't overfill the wrappers — a slightly under-stuffed momo seals better and steams more evenly than an overstuffed one.

recipes.title: Chicken Popcorn (Crispy Airfryer Bites)
recipes.search: chicken popcorn (crispy airfryer bites) chicken popcorn (crispy airfryer bites) chef magic (mix marinade) → airfryer 200°c marinate 20 min + fry 14 min — serves 4 high-protein • everyday prep ahead: marinate the chicken for at least 20 minutes before coating and frying. ingredients 400g boneless chicken, cut into bite-sized pieces 1/2 cup yogurt 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste (adrak-lehsun paste) 1 tsp red chilli powder (lal mirch powder) 1/2 tsp black pepper (kali mirch) 1/2 cup cornflour 1/4 cup all-purpose flour 1 egg, beaten 1 cup breadcrumbs or panko salt to taste oil spray method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 200°c for 4 minutes before adding the food. 2 mix the chicken pieces with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, chilli powder, pepper and salt; marinate for at least 20 minutes. 3 toss the marinated chicken in cornflour and flour, then dip in beaten egg, then coat in breadcrumbs. 4 spray generously with oil and arrange in a single layer in the airfryer basket, without overlapping. 5 air-fry at 200°c for 14 minutes, shaking the basket halfway, until golden and crisp. 6 serve hot with tomato ketchup or a spicy mayo dip. tip: work in batches if the basket looks crowded — popcorn chicken needs airflow around each piece to crisp up properly.

recipes.title: Classic Chicken Nuggets
recipes.search: classic chicken nuggets classic chicken nuggets airfryer – fry 190°c 14 min — makes ~14 high-protein • everyday ingredients 500g boneless chicken breast or thigh, minced or finely chopped 1/2 cup breadcrumbs (for the mix) 1 egg 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp onion powder salt and black pepper to taste 1/2 cup all-purpose flour (for dredging) 1 egg, beaten (for dredging) 1.5 cups breadcrumbs (for coating) oil spray method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 190°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 in a bowl, mix the minced chicken, breadcrumbs, egg, garlic powder, onion powder, salt and pepper until well combined. 3 shape into small nugget-sized ovals. 4 dredge each nugget in flour, dip in the beaten egg, then coat in breadcrumbs, pressing to help them stick. 5 spray lightly with oil and arrange in the basket, spaced apart. 6 air-fry at 190°c for 12–14 minutes, turning halfway, until golden, crisp and cooked through. tip: wetting your hands slightly before shaping the nuggets stops the chicken mixture from sticking to your fingers.

recipes.title: Crispy Chicken Bites (Chilli-Garlic)
recipes.search: crispy chicken bites (chilli-garlic) crispy chicken bites (chilli-garlic) airfryer + chef magic – fry 16 min + sauce 3 min — serves 4 high-protein • indo-chinese • everyday ingredients 500g boneless chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces 1/2 cup cornflour 1/4 cup all-purpose flour 1 egg, beaten salt to taste oil spray 2 tbsp oil 5 cloves garlic, minced 2 green chillies, slit 3 tbsp soy sauce 1 tbsp red chilli sauce 1 tbsp vinegar 1 tsp sugar 2 spring onions, sliced method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 190°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 dip the chicken pieces in the beaten egg, then toss in a mix of cornflour, flour and salt, coating well. 3 spray lightly with oil and arrange in the basket in a single layer. 4 air-fry at 190°c for 14–16 minutes, shaking halfway, until golden and crisp. 5 while the chicken cooks, add the oil, garlic and green chillies to the jar; select sauté (speed 2–3, ~140–150°c) and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. 6 add the soy sauce, chilli sauce, vinegar and sugar; simmer for 2 minutes until slightly thickened, then toss the hot chicken through the sauce. garnish with spring onions and serve immediately. tip: toss the chicken in the sauce just before serving so the coating stays crisp rather than going soft.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Chicken Wings
recipes.search: air fryer chicken wings air fryer chicken wings airfryer – fry 200°c 21 min — serves 4 ingredients 500g chicken wings 1 tbsp oil 1 tsp black pepper (kali mirch) 1 tsp garlic (lehsun) powder salt to taste 1 tbsp hot sauce (optional) method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 200°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 pat wings dry and toss with oil, garlic powder, pepper and salt. 3 arrange in a single layer in the basket. 4 air-fry at 200°c for 21 minutes, flipping halfway, until skin is crisp and golden. 5 toss in hot sauce while hot, if using.

recipes.title: Stuffed Chicken Cheese Balls
recipes.search: stuffed chicken cheese balls stuffed chicken cheese balls airfryer – fry 190°c 13 min makes ~10 ingredients 250g minced/shredded cooked chicken 1/2 cup mozzarella, cubed small 1 tbsp mayonnaise 1 tsp chilli flakes 1/2 cup breadcrumbs 1 egg, beaten oil spray method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 190°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 mix chicken, mayonnaise and chilli flakes; shape portions around a cheese cube into balls. 3 dip each ball in beaten egg, then coat in breadcrumbs. 4 spray with oil and arrange in the basket, spaced apart. 5 air-fry at 190°c for 13 minutes, turning once, until golden and cheese is melted inside.

recipes.title: Jalapeño Poppers
recipes.search: jalapeño poppers jalapeño poppers airfryer – bake 180°c 11 min makes ~12 ingredients 6 jalapeños, halved and seeded 1/2 cup cream cheese, softened 1/4 cup grated cheddar 1/4 tsp garlic (lehsun) powder 6 strips bacon, halved (optional) method 1 preheat: preheat the airfryer to 180°c for 4 minutes before adding the food to the basket. 2 mix cream cheese, cheddar and garlic powder; spoon into jalapeño halves. 3 wrap each with a piece of bacon if using, securing with a toothpick. 4 arrange in the basket, cut-side up. 5 bake at 180°c for 11 minutes until peppers soften and the topping is bubbling.

recipes.title: Chicken Tikka Masala
recipes.search: chicken tikka masala chicken tikka masala airfryer (grill the tikka) → chef magic (make the 200°c grill 15 min + gravy 18 min gravy) — serves 4 gluten-free • high-protein • everyday prep ahead: marinate the chicken for at least 30 minutes (overnight deepens the flavour). ingredients 500g boneless chicken, cubed 1/2 cup thick yogurt 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste (adrak-lehsun paste) 1.5 tsp tikka masala or garam masala 1 tsp red chilli powder (lal mirch powder) 1 tbsp mustard oil (sarson ka tel) 2 onions, chopped 2 tomatoes, pureed 1 tbsp butter 1/2 cup cream 1 tsp kasuri methi (dried fenugreek (methi)) salt to taste method 1 preheat: when you reach the airfryer step, preheat it to 200°c for 4 minutes before adding the food. 2 mix the chicken with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, tikka masala, chilli powder, mustard oil and salt; marinate for at least 3 minutes. 4 arrange the chicken in a single layer in the airfryer basket. 5 grill at 200°c for 15 minutes, turning once, until charred at the edges and cooked through. 6 in chef magic, add butter; select sauté (speed 2–4, ~130–160°c) and cook the onions for 6 minutes until golden. 7 add the tomatoes and cook for 8 minutes until the oil separates. 8 add the grilled chicken, cream and kasuri methi; simmer on sauté (speed 1–2, ~100–110°c) for 4 minutes and serve hot. tip: grilling the chicken first (rather than boiling it in the gravy) is what gives tikka masala its charred, tandoori flavour — don’t

recipes.title: Chicken Biryani (Dum-Style)
